body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 加拿大人对激进的环保活动的容忍度取决于几个因素。但总体而言，加拿大人不支持以破坏公物或暴力作为抗议形式。这些是麦吉尔大学和拉瓦尔大学研究人员进行的一项新研究的主要发现。研究结果发表在《加拿大政治学杂志》上。 “有一条非常明确的红线：人们接受和平策略，对破坏性的抗议形式犹豫不决，但几乎一致拒绝将破坏和暴力作为政治竞争的手段。即使是那些对气候变化表示强烈担忧的人也不会跨越这条线，”麦吉尔大学政治学系博士后研究员、该研究的主要作者亚历克西斯·比博-加格农(Alexis Bibeau-Gagnon)说。 研究小组分析了 2022 年夏季对 1,500 名加拿大人进行的一项调查的数据。 研究结果表明，年轻人（33 岁以下）、更关心气候变化的人以及相信政府或大公司而非个人对气候变化负有主要责任的人更有可能容忍破坏性的环境抗议形式。然而，即使在这些群体内部，接受的门槛也没有延伸到暴力。 调查参与者被要求表明他们对环境活动人士一系列日益激进的策略的支持程度，从签署请愿书到对掌权者实施暴力。其他策略包括撤资运动、封锁道路或桥梁以及破坏行为。 受访者还被问及他们认为哪些群体对气候变化负有最大责任——个人、政府或大公司——以及他们对气候危机的担忧程度。 比博-加格农说：“这有助于解释为什么气候运动中更激进的部分难以赢得公众支持，尽管人们对气候变化的担忧持续增长。” “它揭示了我们认为民主社会中解决气候变化的紧迫性与不支持更激进行动方法的公众所施加的限制之间的根本紧张关系。” 这项调查是由拉瓦尔大学绿色经济研究观察站和社会数字科学领导力主席委托进行的，并由民意调查公司 Synopsis 进行。 比博-加格农的更广泛的研究重点是激进的政治抗议，包括民主社会中的骚乱和破坏性集体行动，他说他计划……

reflection.en: The news highlights a tension: while most Canadians draw a line at destructive protest, a segment, particularly the young and eco-anxious, are drawn to more disruptive tactics. This yearning for environmental justice, even when expressed through methods that cross societal norms, echoes the prophet Amos's call for justice to 'roll on like a river, like a...
reflection.zh: 这则新闻揭示了一种张力：尽管大多数加拿大人在破坏性抗议面前划定了界限，但一部分人，特别是年轻且有环保焦虑的群体，却被更具颠覆性的策略所吸引。这种对环境正义的渴望，即使是以越过社会规范的方式表达，也呼应了先知阿摩司‘愿公平如大水滚滚，如小河滔滔’的呼吁。挑战在于如何将这份对受造界的关怀的热情，引导到既有效又符合更广泛和平与尊重原则的途径上。

verse.textEn: Let justice roll on like a river, righteousness like a never-failing stream!
verse.textZh: 惟愿公平如大水滚滚，使公义如江河滔滔。

title.en: History is being rewritten at an archaeological site in Morocco. What the discovery of an ancient wall tells us
title.zh: 摩洛哥考古遗址改写历史：古墙的发现告诉我们什么

summary.en: Archaeological research at Oued Beht in northwestern Morocco has uncovered a substantial built structure, indicating that communities in the region were actively shaping their environment and engaging in broader Mediterranean networks during the second millennium BC. This discovery suggests a previously unknown...
summary.zh: 摩洛哥西北部韦德·贝赫特（Oued Beht）的考古研究发现了一处重要的建筑遗迹，表明在公元前二千纪，该地区的社群积极地改造着他们的环境，并参与到更广泛的地中海交流网络中。这一发现揭示了该地区一段此前未知的历史。

body.en: In the hills of northwestern Morocco, overlooking the river that gives the site its name, research at Oued Beht is bringing to light a previously unknown chapter of the region's past. The discovery of a substantial built structure suggests that, during the second millennium BC, communities in northwestern Africa were actively shaping their environment. They were also engaging in broader networks of interaction across the Mediterranean world.
body.zh: 在摩洛哥西北部的山区，瓦德贝特 (Oued Beht) 的研究正在揭开该地区过去未知的篇章，俯瞰着该地区得名的河流。大量建筑结构的发现表明，在公元前第二个千年，非洲西北部的社区正在积极塑造他们的环境。他们还参与了整个地中海世界更广泛的互动网络。

reflection.en: The discovery at Oued Beht reveals ancient peoples actively shaping their world, a testament to human ingenuity and interaction. Job 12:7 reminds us that creation itself speaks, offering wisdom through observation. These ancient builders, like all of humanity, were part of the intricate tapestry of God's creation, their endeavors echoing the ongoing story...
reflection.zh: 韦德·贝赫特遗址的发现揭示了古代人民积极塑造世界的能力，这是人类智慧和互动的证明。约伯记12:7提醒我们，创造本身会说话，通过观察就能获得智慧。这些古代建造者，如同全人类一样，是雅伟创造的复杂织锦的一部分，他们的努力呼应着人类与世界互动的持续故事。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Tracking the path of new world screwworm
title.zh: 追踪新世界螺旋蝇的路径

summary.en: Recent outbreaks of New World screwworm in the United States underscore the importance of tracking its spread to anticipate future infestations. Researchers at the USDA's Agricultural Research Service are using predictive models as a proactive strategy to manage the pest, enabling earlier and faster responses to...
summary.zh: 新世界螺旋蝇在美国近期出现新的疫情，凸显了追踪其传播路径以预测未来侵扰的关键需求。美国农业部农业研究局的研究人员正在采用预测模型作为管理这种害虫的前瞻性策略，使农业部各机构能够更早、更快地做出反应，将资源导向最需要的地方，以保护美国的牲畜、宠物和野生动物。

body.en: New cases of New World screwworm have recently surfaced in the United States, highlighting the critical need to track its paths to determine where future infestations may occur. Researchers at the U.S. Department of Agriculture's (USDA) Agricultural Research Service (ARS) are employing predictive models as part of a forward-thinking approach to manage New World screwworm. This strategy allows USDA agencies to act earlier, respond faster and direct resources where they are most needed to protect U.S. livestock, pets and wildlife.
body.zh: 美国最近出现了新世界螺旋虫病例，凸显了追踪其路径以确定未来可能发生感染的迫切需要。美国农业部 (USDA) 农业研究服务处 (ARS) 的研究人员正在采用预测模型作为管理新世界螺旋蝇的前瞻性方法的一部分。这一战略使美国农业部机构能够更早采取行动，更快做出反应，并将资源分配到最需要的地方，以保护美国牲畜、宠物和野生动物。

reflection.en: The natural world, in all its complexity, offers profound lessons. By observing the patterns of pests like the New World screwworm, scientists gain insights that help protect vulnerable populations. This diligent study reflects a deep engagement with creation, revealing the wisdom inherent in Yahweh's intricate designs.
reflection.zh: 大自然以其复杂性，提供了深刻的教训。通过观察新世界螺旋蝇等害虫的模式，科学家们获得了有助于保护弱势群体的见解。这种勤奋的研究反映了对受造界的深入参与，揭示了雅伟精妙设计中所固有的智慧。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Plans to artificially dim the sun have divided scientists—here's what they're actually arguing about
title.zh: 太阳变暗的计划引起了科学家的分歧——他们到底在争论什么

summary.en: The article debunks common online conspiracy theories, such as the government engineering hurricanes or spraying 'chemtrails,' and distinguishes them from the genuine scientific debate surrounding geoengineering proposals like solar radiation management.
summary.zh: 文章驳斥了常见的在线阴谋论，例如政府制造飓风或喷洒“化学凝结尾迹”，并将它们与围绕地球工程（如太阳辐射管理）的真实科学辩论区分开来。

body.en:
This article has been reviewed according to Science X's editorial process and policies . Editors have highlighted the following attributes while ensuring the content's credibility:

No, President Joe Biden did not engineer Hurricane Milton. No, the ice crystal contrails left behind by high-altitude aircraft are not "chemtrails" sprayed by governments to control the weather or manipulate populations. No, state-run cloud seeding did not cause the record floods in Dubai .

Yet claims like these are widespread online and increasingly find their way into political rhetoric . This blurs the distinction between conspiracy theories about weather manipulation and the very real scientific debate over solar geoengineering.

Solar geoengineering, also known as solar radiation modification (SRM), would try to temporarily cool the climate by altering the amount of energy entering or leaving the Earth system. Outdoor field experiments are particularly contentious, with researchers and other experts divided over whether they should proceed at all and, if so, under what conditions .

The best-known proposal, stratospheric aerosol injection , involves dispersing sulfur dioxide high in the atmosphere, where it can form reflective particles known as aerosols. These can remain in the stratosphere for long periods, broadly mimicking the cooling effect of major volcanic eruptions.

The other main proposals are marine cloud brightening , which would add sea-salt particles to low clouds over the sea to make them more reflective, and cirrus cloud thinning , which would aim to reduce the net warming effect of high-altitude clouds.

In our recent study , colleagues and I examined what outdoor SRM experiments might look like in practice. We identified plausible experiments across the three approaches and examined how their scientific purpose and regulatory requirements change with scale. The paper is published in the journal Earth's Future .

Rather than a simple "small" or "large" distinction, we found discrete phases with increasingly stringent regulatory scrutiny at each stage—think of it like a steep staircase as scale increases.

I focus here on stratospheric aerosol injection, the most extensively studied proposal, as it best illustrates the gulf between experimentation and deployment.

Recent simulations suggest that around 8 to 16 million tonnes of sulfur dioxide would need to be injected each year to produce 1°C of cooling. An interactive simulator lets you experiment with these numbers yourself.

Proposed outdoor research could start with vastly smaller releases. Our study identified a range of plausible trials of increasing size and the questions each could answer. The smallest trials could examine aerosol formation or compare how different particles behave in the...
body.zh: 本文已根据 Science X 的编辑流程和政策进行审阅。编辑在确保内容可信度的同时强调了以下属性： 不，乔·拜登总统没有策划飓风米尔顿。不，高空飞机留下的冰晶尾迹并不是政府为了控制天气或操纵人口而喷洒的“化学尾迹”。不，国营人工降雨并未导致迪拜创纪录的洪水。 然而，此类言论在网上广泛传播，并越来越多地进入政治言论。这模糊了关于天气操纵的阴谋论和关于太阳地球工程的非常真实的科学辩论之间的区别。 太阳能地球工程，也称为太阳辐射修正（SRM），将尝试通过改变进入或离开地球系统的能量来暂时冷却气候。户外现场实验特别有争议，研究人员和其他专家对于是否应该进行实验以及如果应该进行则在什么条件下进行存在分歧。 最著名的提议是平流层气溶胶注入，涉及将二氧化硫分散在大气中的高处，在那里它可以形成被称为气溶胶的反射颗粒。它们可以在平流层中停留很长时间，大致模仿大型火山喷发的冷却效果。 其他主要建议是海洋云增亮，即在海上低云中添加海盐颗粒，使其更具反射性；以及卷云稀疏化，旨在减少高空云的净变暖效应。 在我们最近的研究中，我和同事研究了室外 SRM 实验在实践中的情况。我们确定了这三种方法的合理实验，并研究了它们的科学目的和监管要求如何随着规模的变化而变化。该论文发表在《地球的未来》杂志上。 我们发现，每个阶段都有越来越严格的监管审查，而不是简单的“小”或“大”区别——可以把它想象成随着规模增加而出现的陡峭楼梯。 我在这里重点关注平流层气溶胶注入，这是研究最广泛的提议，因为它最好地说明了实验和部署之间的鸿沟。 最近的模拟表明，每年需要注入约 8 至 1600 万吨二氧化硫才能产生 1°C 的冷却效果。交互式模拟器可以让您自己尝试这些数字。 拟议的户外研究可以从规模小得多的版本开始。我们的研究确定了一系列看似合理的试验，其规模不断增加，并且每个试验都可以回答一些问题。最小的试验可以检查气溶胶的形成或比较不同颗粒在...

reflection.en: The rapid spread of unfounded claims online, as seen with conspiracy theories about weather manipulation, highlights a societal struggle with discernment. Proverbs 14:15 reminds us that the simple believe every word, but the prudent give thought to their steps. In an age of information overload, cultivating the wisdom to distinguish truth from falsehood is...
reflection.zh: 正如关于天气操纵的阴谋论所见，毫无根据的说法在网上迅速传播，这凸显了社会在辨别力方面的挣扎。《箴言》14:15提醒我们，愚人凡事都信，通达人步步而谨慎。在这个信息爆炸的时代，培养区分真伪的智慧是一种至关重要的属灵操练。

verse.textEn: The simple believe anything, but the prudent give thought to their steps.
verse.textZh: 愚蒙人是话都信；通达人步步谨慎。

title.en: What are best options for controlling GSL dust, and what would they cost?
title.zh: 控制大盐湖尘埃的最佳选择是什么，以及它们的成本是多少？

summary.en: A new collaborative report from University of Utah researchers, coordinated by the Wilkes Center for Climate Science & Policy, offers a comprehensive analysis to Utah state agencies and policymakers regarding the increasing risks from dust originating from the exposed lakebed of the Great Salt Lake. The report details...
summary.zh: 犹他大学研究人员的一份新合作报告，由威尔克斯气候科学与政策中心协调，为犹他州自然资源部、环境保护部和政策制定者提供了对大盐湖裸露湖床尘埃日益增长的风险、控制这些尘埃的潜在成本以及稳定湖泊水位带来的长期效益的全面分析。

body.en: A new collaborative report from University of Utah researchers and coordinated by the Wilkes Center for Climate Science & Policy provides Utah Department of Natural Resources, Department of Environmental Quality and policymakers with a comprehensive analysis of the growing risks posed by dust from the exposed lakebed of Great Salt Lake, the potential costs of controlling that dust, and the long-term benefits of stabilizing lake levels.
body.zh: 犹他大学研究人员在威尔克斯气候科学与政策中心的协调下发布了一份新的合作报告，为犹他州自然资源部、环境质量部和政策制定者提供了一份全面分析，内容涉及大盐湖裸露湖床的灰尘带来的日益增长的风险、控制灰尘的潜在成本以及稳定湖水位的长期效益。

reflection.en: This report represents a significant effort to understand and address a growing environmental challenge. It highlights the value of diligent research and analysis in confronting complex issues, reminding us that seeking knowledge is a fundamental human endeavor, and often the first step toward wise solutions. The pursuit of understanding, as Proverbs...
reflection.zh: 这份报告代表了理解和应对日益严峻的环境挑战的重要努力。它强调了勤奋研究和分析在应对复杂问题中的价值，提醒我们寻求知识是一项基本的人类事业，并且常常是明智解决方案的第一步。正如箴言所说，追求理解使我们能够应对困难，并努力创造一个更健康、更美好的未来。

verse.textEn: The heart of the discerning acquires knowledge, for the ears of the wise seek it out.
verse.textZh: 聪明人的心得知识；智慧人的耳求知识。

title.en: Warning of space arms race as US confirms weapons in Earth's orbit
title.zh: 美国证实地球轨道部署武器，预警太空军备竞赛

summary.en: The US has confirmed the deployment of a space weapon in Earth's orbit, marking the first acknowledgment of such offensive capabilities. Defense correspondent Jonathan Beale explains the potential implications of a space arms race.
summary.zh: 美国已证实其在地球轨道部署了一枚太空武器，这是首次承认此类进攻性能力。国防事务记者乔纳森·比尔解释了太空军备竞赛的潜在影响。

body.en:
The US has confirmed it deployed a space weapon in Earth's orbit, the first time it has acknowledged such offensive capabilities.

However, according to the BBC's Defence correspondent Jonathan Beale, this is already happening.
body.zh: 美国确认在地球轨道上部署了太空武器，这是美国首次承认此类进攻能力。 然而，据英国广播公司 (BBC) 防务记者乔纳森·比尔 (Jonathan Beale) 报道，这种情况已经发生。

reflection.en: The confirmation of a space weapon deployment by the US raises concerns about a potential arms race in orbit. Isaiah's vision of nations beating their swords into plowshares and spears into pruning hooks offers a stark contrast to this escalation, calling for a future where military might is transformed into tools for peace and productivity.
reflection.zh: 美国证实部署太空武器，引发了对轨道军备竞赛的担忧。以赛亚先知看见各国将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀的异象，与这种升级形成了鲜明对比，呼唤着一个将军事力量转化为和平与生产力工具的未来。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Why weapons used in space could impact us all
title.zh: 太空武器的使用可能影响我们所有人

summary.en: The US has confirmed it deployed a space weapon in Earth's orbit, marking the first time it has acknowledged such offensive capabilities.
summary.zh: 美国已确认其在地球轨道上部署了太空武器，这是其首次承认拥有此类进攻性能力。

reflection.en: The deployment of a space weapon by the US marks a significant escalation in military technology, pushing conflict into a new domain. While nations pursue such capabilities, the Psalmist reminds us that ultimate power rests with Yahweh, who can bring an end to all warfare. This news invites reflection on humanity's drive for dominance and the hope found in...
reflection.zh: 美国部署太空武器标志着军事技术的重大升级，将冲突推向了一个新领域。尽管各国都在追求此类能力，但诗人提醒我们，最终的权柄在于雅伟，祂能终结一切战争。这一消息促使我们反思人类对主导地位的追求，以及在神圣干预下建立和平的希望。

verse.textEn: He makes wars cease to the ends of the earth; he breaks the bow and shatters the spear.
verse.textZh: 他止息刀兵，直到地极；他折弓断枪。

title.en: AI models chatting in ‘surreal’ dialect mixing poetic language and tech bro jargon
title.zh: 人工智能模型以一种混合了诗意语言和科技行业术语的超现实方言进行聊天

summary.en: Experts are concerned about AI language that resembles James Joyce's prose and tech bro jargon, making monitoring and oversight difficult. AI agents are rapidly developing new dialects that are hard for humans to comprehend, posing challenges for behavior monitoring.
summary.zh: 专家们对人工智能语言表示担忧，这种语言既有詹姆斯·乔伊斯式的散文风格，又有科技行业的行话，使得监控和监督变得困难。人工智能代理正在迅速发展新的方言，人类难以理解，这对行为监控构成了挑战。

body.en: Experts air concern over AI lingo redolent of James Joyce’s prose that is creating barriers to monitoring and oversight AI models have begun communicating in a strange new version of English that reads like a cross between James Joyce’s Finnegans Wake and tech bro jargon, new research has found. Autonomous AI agents are rapidly creating novel dialects allowing them to converse in an often barely comprehensible language, which risks making it harder for humans to monitor their behaviour. Continue reading...
body.zh: 专家们对让人想起詹姆斯·乔伊斯散文的人工智能术语表示担忧，这给监控和监督带来了麻烦。新的研究发现，人工智能模型已经开始用一种奇怪的新英语版本进行交流，这种英语读起来像是詹姆斯·乔伊斯的《芬尼根守灵夜》和科技兄弟行话的混合体。自主人工智能代理正在迅速创造新的方言，使他们能够用一种通常难以理解的语言进行交谈，这可能会让人类更难监控他们的行为。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid evolution of AI communication, creating 'surreal' dialects, highlights a growing gap between human understanding and machine intelligence. As knowledge and complexity increase, as described in Daniel 12:4, we are called to seek wisdom and discernment to navigate these new frontiers, ensuring our oversight remains effective.
reflection.zh: 人工智能交流的快速发展，创造出“超现实”的方言，凸显了人类理解与机器智能之间日益扩大的差距。正如但以理书12:4所述，随着知识和复杂性的增加，我们被呼召寻求智慧和分辨力，以驾驭这些新领域，确保我们的监督保持有效。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Smelling chocolate helped men complete more reps without feeling more tired
title.zh: 闻巧克力让男性完成更多次腿部训练，且不感觉更累

summary.en: A study found that smelling chocolate, particularly dark chocolate, before and during resistance exercise helped men complete more leg extension repetitions without increasing their perceived exertion. Researchers suggest familiar food aromas might influence appetite and motivation.
summary.zh: 一项研究发现，在阻力训练前和训练期间闻到巧克力的气味，特别是黑巧克力，可以帮助男性完成更多的腿部伸展重复次数，而不会增加他们的感觉劳累程度。研究人员推测，熟悉的食物香气可能会影响食欲和动机。

body.en:
A tough leg day may have an unexpectedly simple boost: the smell of chocolate. According to a new study published in Frontiers in Physiology , exposure to chocolate aromas before and during resistance exercise helped participants complete more repetitions without making the workout feel more difficult.

"Exposing moderately trained men to chocolate odors right before and between sets of resistance exercise significantly increased their overall training volume without increasing their perceived exertion," said senior author Dr. Mohamed Nashrudin bin Naharudin, an assistant professor at the Faculty of Sports and Exercise Science at the University of Malaya. "Seeing a substantial increase in repetitions without the athletes feeling like they were exerting themselves any harder is a fascinating psychobiological outcome."

The study included 23 healthy men in their early to mid-20s who were moderately trained. Researchers separated them into three groups and exposed each group to one of three samples: liquified dark chocolate containing 90% cocoa, liquified milk chocolate containing 60% cocoa, or water as a control.

"We know olfaction is powerfully wired into the brain's appetite and emotion networks, but surprisingly, no study has systematically looked at the three-way interaction between smell, appetite, and actual resistance exercise capacity," said Nashrudin Naharudin.

Before exercising, the participants had gone without food for at least 10 hours. They then performed leg extensions, an exercise in which a person sits and straightens the lower legs against resistance to lift a weight.

Researchers measured leg extension performance both before and during the training session. Before exercising, participants also rated their hunger, fullness, desire to eat, and intention to eat in the near future. While completing their sets, researchers measured hunger and desire to eat after each 30-second exposure to one of the scent samples.

Compared with both the water control and milk chocolate conditions, smelling dark chocolate was consistently associated with lower hunger, less desire and intention to eat, and greater feelings of fullness before exercise. The dark chocolate aroma therefore appeared to reduce appetite mainly by decreasing hunger and increasing perceived fullness.

Milk chocolate had a different effect. Participants rated its smell as more pleasant than either dark chocolate or water, but the aroma did not significantly change their hunger or appetite.

The effects were not limited to appetite. Chocolate aromas also appeared to influence how much exercise the participants could complete.

"Sniffing a 90% dark chocolate odor added about 18 more repetitions to participants' leg extensions, while a 60% milk chocolate odor added about nine...
body.zh: 艰难的腿部日可能会有一个意想不到的简单的提升：巧克力的味道。根据发表在《生理学前沿》上的一项新研究，在抗阻运动之前和过程中接触巧克力香气可以帮助参与者完成更多的重复次数，而不会让锻炼感觉更加困难。 马来亚大学运动与运动科学学院助理教授、资深作者穆罕默德·纳什鲁丁·本·纳哈鲁丁博士说：“在进行抗阻训练之前和之间，让接受过中等训练的男性接触巧克力气味，可以显着增加他们的整体训练量，而不会增加他们的体力感知。” “看到重复次数大幅增加，而运动员却没有感觉自己更加努力，这是一个令人着迷的心理生物学结果。” 该研究纳入了 23 名 20 岁出头至中期的健康男性，他们接受过中等训练。研究人员将他们分成三组，让每组接触三种样品之一：含有 90% 可可的液态黑巧克力、含有 60% 可可的液态牛奶巧克力，或作为对照的水。 纳什鲁丁·纳哈鲁丁说：“我们知道嗅觉与大脑的食欲和情绪网络密切相关，但令人惊讶的是，没有研究系统地研究嗅觉、食欲和实际抵抗运动能力之间的三向相互作用。” 运动前，参与者至少有 10 个小时没有进食。然后，他们进行了腿部伸展运动，在这项运动中，一个人坐着并伸直小腿以对抗阻力以举起重物。 研究人员在训练前和训练期间测量了腿部伸展表现。在运动前，参与者还对自己的饥饿感、饱腹感、进食欲望以及近期进食意愿进行了评分。在完成一组实验时，研究人员测量了每接触一种气味样本 30 秒后的饥饿感和进食欲望。 与控制水和牛奶巧克力条件相比，闻黑巧克力的味道始终与较低的饥饿感、较少的进食欲望和意图以及运动前的饱腹感有关。因此，黑巧克力香气似乎主要通过减少饥饿感和增加饱腹感来降低食欲。 牛奶巧克力有不同的效果。参与者认为它的气味比黑巧克力或水更令人愉悦，但这种香气并没有显着改变他们的饥饿或食欲。 影响不仅限于食欲。巧克力香气似乎也会影响参与者完成的运动量。 “闻 90% 的黑巧克力气味，参与者的腿部伸展次数增加了约 18 次，而 60% 的牛奶巧克力气味则增加了约 9 次......

reflection.en: The pursuit of physical fitness often involves pushing our limits. This study suggests that even in strenuous activity, our senses can play a role in our performance and perception of effort. Whether in the gym or in our daily tasks, Colossians 3:23 reminds us to approach all our endeavors with diligence, as if working for a higher purpose.
reflection.zh: 追求体能健康常常需要我们挑战极限。这项研究表明，即使在剧烈运动中，我们的感官也能影响我们的表现和对劳累的感知。无论是在健身房还是在日常的劳作中，歌罗西书3:23提醒我们，要以勤勉的态度对待我们所有的努力，仿佛是为主而做。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: This Australian cave hid 25,000 years of ritual secrets
title.zh: 这座澳大利亚洞穴隐藏了 25,000 年的仪式秘密

summary.en: Microscopic plant remains are revealing how GunaiKurnai ancestors used Cloggs Cave for ritual practices over thousands of years. People deliberately gathered whole grasses, carried them into the dark cave, and burned them in thin layers, leaving behind traces that may span 25,000 years. A standing stone erected around...
summary.zh: 微观植物遗骸揭示了 GunaiKurnai 祖先数千年来如何使用 Cloggs 洞穴进行仪式活动。人们故意收集整株草，将其带入黑暗的洞穴，并以薄层燃烧，留下了可能跨越 25,000 年的痕迹。大约 2,000 年前竖立的石碑和其他仪式物品加强了该洞穴是一个长期存在的精神场所的证据。

body.en: Microscopic plant remains are revealing how GunaiKurnai ancestors used Cloggs Cave for ritual practices over thousands of years. People deliberately gathered whole grasses, carried them into the dark cave, and burned them in thin layers, leaving behind traces that may span 25,000 years. A standing stone erected around 2,000 years ago and other ritual objects strengthen the evidence that the cave was a long-lived spiritual site.
body.zh: 微观植物遗骸揭示了古奈库尔奈 (GunaiKurnai) 祖先数千年来如何利用克洛格斯洞穴 (Cloggs Cave) 进行仪式活动。人们故意把整株草收集起来，带进黑暗的洞穴，薄薄地烧掉，留下的痕迹可能跨越25000年。大约 2000 年前竖立的立石和其他仪式物品进一步证明该洞穴是一个长期存在的精神场所。

reflection.en: For millennia, the GunaiKurnai people found spiritual meaning and connection within Cloggs Cave, using the natural world—grasses gathered and burned—as part of their rituals. This ancient practice reminds us that wisdom and sacredness can be discovered through careful observation and interaction with creation itself. The enduring traces left behind speak to...
reflection.zh: 数千年来，GunaiKurnai 人在 Cloggs 洞穴中找到了精神意义和联系，将自然界——收集和燃烧的草——作为他们仪式的一部分。这种古老的做法提醒我们，通过仔细观察和与受造物本身的互动，可以发现智慧和神圣。留下的持久痕迹诉说着对地方和实践的深切、长久的敬畏。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: Scientists discover a major brain shift between ages 50 and 75
title.zh: 科学家发现50至75岁之间大脑发生重大转变

summary.en: Scientists have uncovered sweeping changes in how the human brain controls and organizes its genome beginning in midlife, offering new clues to why aging sharply increases the risk of Alzheimer’s and other neurodegenerative diseases. One of the biggest shifts occurred between about ages 50 and 75, when many of the...
summary.zh: 科学家们发现，从中老年开始，人脑控制和组织其基因组的方式发生了广泛变化，这为衰老如何急剧增加阿尔茨海默病和其他神经退行性疾病的风险提供了新线索。其中最大的变化发生在50至75岁之间，此时大脑的许多原始免疫细胞减少，并被更具炎症特征的细胞取代。研究人员还发现，有助于维持血脑屏障的细胞功能减弱，并且基因组的三维组织也普遍恶...

body.en: Scientists have uncovered sweeping changes in how the human brain controls and organizes its genome beginning in midlife, offering new clues to why aging sharply increases the risk of Alzheimer’s and other neurodegenerative diseases. One of the biggest shifts occurred between about ages 50 and 75, when many of the brain’s original immune cells declined and were replaced by cells with more inflammatory characteristics. Researchers also found weakening of cells that help maintain the blood-brain barrier, along with widespread deterioration in the genome’s three-dimensional organization.
body.zh: 科学家们发现，人类大脑从中年开始控制和组织基因组的方式发生了巨大变化，为解释为什么衰老会急剧增加阿尔茨海默病和其他神经退行性疾病的风险提供了新的线索。最大的转变之一发生在大约 50 岁到 75 岁之间，此时大脑的许多原始免疫细胞下降，并被具有更多炎症特征的细胞所取代。研究人员还发现，有助于维持血脑屏障的细胞减弱，基因组三维组织普遍恶化。

reflection.en: The human brain, a marvel of creation, continues to reveal its intricate workings as we age. This research, spanning decades of life, shows how even our genetic control centers shift and change. As we observe these biological processes, we can reflect on the profound wisdom embedded within the natural world, a testament to its Creator.
reflection.zh: 人脑作为造物的奇迹，随着年龄的增长，其错综复杂的功能不断被揭示。这项跨越数十年生命的研究表明，即使是我们基因控制中心也在发生变化。当我们观察这些生物过程时，可以反思自然界中蕴含的深刻智慧，这是其创造者的明证。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: What weapon could the US have put into space?
title.zh: 美国可能在太空中部署了什么武器？

summary.en: The United States has announced the deployment of a weapon in Earth's orbit, sparking questions about the nature of space-based weaponry and its role in the strategic competition among major powers for dominance in this domain. The US Secretary of the Air Force stated the weapon is for safeguarding American forces but...
summary.zh: 美国宣布已在地球轨道上部署了一件武器，这引发了关于太空武器性质及其在主要大国争夺太空主导权中的作用的疑问。美国空军部长表示，该武器旨在保护美军，但未提供有关其能力或部署时间的具体细节。

body.en:
The announcement by the United States that it has deployed a space weapon in Earth's orbit has raised questions about what weaponry is actually in space, and what role it could play in efforts by great powers to dominate that arena.

Washington has given away little in its announcement. Secretary of the Air Force Troy Meink said the "on orbit" weapon was necessary to safeguard US forces against hostile enemy action, but gave no details about the weapon's capabilities or when it was put into orbit.

So what could this weapon be, and what is the wider picture like for military developments in space? Who else could have similar weaponry?

Space has been a militarised domain since the start of the space age - in the late 1960s, the Soviet Union deployed weapons up there. The Istrebitel Sputnikov (IS; Satellite Destroyer) programme was made up of satellites that were designed to release projectiles that detonated, releasing shrapnel into the path of another (usually American) satellite.

Nowadays, advanced militaries deploy satellites in space for a range of purposes, including reconnaissance, secure communications, detecting missile launches and providing precise location information for targeted strikes.

As warfare becomes more technologically advanced, analysts expect the use of military hardware in space to increase.

Dr Bleddyn Bowen, an associate fellow in military sciences at the Royal United Services Institute and associate professor in astropolitics at Durham University, said he was only able to hazard a guess about the weapon announced by the US.

"I would expect there to be some kind of electronic warfare or radio-jamming platform, possibly, this would be a non-destructive kind of anti-satellite weapon," he told BBC Radio 4's Today programme.

Such weaponry already exists on Earth and can disrupt satellite communications, he said. "If you take out the radio links then your satellite is very useless."

Bowen also would not rule out a riskier and more disruptive type of weaponry, which could create debris and destruction.

"Less likely would be a kinetic kill vehicle of some sort, so a vehicle that would release a projectile that could ram into a satellite and destroy it," he said.

A type of "close inspection and grappling satellite would be another possibility as well."

As to whether rivals such as Russia and China have similar weaponry already in orbit, is difficult to tell.

"If we're looking towards China and Russia, they have both displayed activity," Juliana Suess, a former research fellow at RUSI and researcher at the Stiftung Wissenschaft und Politik (German Institute for International and Security Affairs), told the BBC.

"For example, with Russia, we've seen some activity that hints at being a co-orbital weapons test. So we saw...
body.zh: 美国宣布在地球轨道上部署太空武器，引发了人们的疑问：太空中到底有哪些武器，以及它在大国主导太空领域的努力中可以发挥什么作用。 华盛顿在声明中没有透露太多信息。美国空军部长特洛伊·梅克表示，“在轨”武器对于保护美军免受敌方行动是必要的，但没有透露该武器的能力或何时进入轨道的详细信息。 那么这种武器会是什么？太空军事发展的更广阔前景是怎样的？还有谁能拥有类似的武器？ 先进军队已经在太空中部署卫星用于多种用途，从提供安全通信到侦察，以及为有针对性的打击和探测导弹发射提供精确的位置信息。 随着战争技术变得更加先进，分析人士预计太空军事硬件的使用将会增加。 英国皇家联合军种研究所军事科学研究所副研究员、杜伦大学天体政治学副教授布莱丁·鲍文博士表示，他只能对美国宣布的这种武器进行大胆猜测。 “我预计会有某种电子战或无线电干扰平台，这可能是一种非破坏性的反卫星武器，”他告诉英国广播公司第四台“今日”节目。 他说，这种武器已经存在于地球上，并且可以扰乱卫星通信。 “如果你去掉无线电链路，那么你的卫星就毫无用处了。” 鲍文也不排除某种更具破坏性和风险性的武器，这可能会造成大量碎片和破坏。 他说：“不太可能是某种动能杀伤飞行器，因此可以释放某种射弹，撞击卫星并摧毁它。” “也许某种近距离检查和擒抱卫星也是另一种可能性。” 不过，虽然这种进入轨道的武器似乎是首创，但美国——实际上还有俄罗斯和中国的竞争对手——拥有可以瞄准并射入太空的武器已有一段时间了。 事实上，在过去十年中，俄罗斯和中国在太空进行了更多的演习，称为交会和邻近操作（RPO）——“嗡嗡”西方卫星。 伦敦国王学院俄罗斯国防与安全研究系的读者罗德·桑顿博士告诉英国广播公司：“理论上，这些 RPO 卫星可以通过与它们发生物理碰撞或将它们推出轨道而成为猎杀卫星。” 鲍文补充说，中国人已经展示了“太空拖拽能力”，他说：“飞行器可以到达卫星，可以抓住它并将其移入不同的轨道。” 他说，这可以...

reflection.en: The announcement of a new weapon in Earth's orbit signals a concerning escalation in the militarization of space. As nations develop advanced capabilities for this new frontier, the prophetic vision of Isaiah 2:4, where weapons are transformed into tools for agriculture, offers a stark contrast and a hopeful alternative to the current trajectory of an arms...
reflection.zh: 在地球轨道上部署新武器的声明，标志着太空军事化令人担忧的升级。随着各国为这片新边疆开发先进能力，以赛亚书2:4中将武器转化为农具的预言性景象，与当前太空军备竞赛的轨迹形成了鲜明对比，并提供了一个充满希望的替代方案。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: UV light reveals possible camouflage on a 125-million-year-old crocodile
title.zh: 紫外光揭示1.25亿年前鳄鱼可能存在的伪装

summary.en: A remarkably preserved fossil of a crocodile relative from 125 million years ago has revealed skin, sensory organs, and respiratory structures. Using ultraviolet light, researchers discovered alternating bands on its tail, suggesting a potential camouflage pattern, offering new insights into the creature's life.
summary.zh: 一块保存完好的1.25亿年前鳄鱼近亲化石，揭示了其皮肤、感觉器官和呼吸结构。研究人员利用紫外光发现了其尾部交替的条带，表明可能存在伪装图案，为科学家们提供了关于这种生物生活的新见解。

body.en:
A remarkably preserved fossil from northeastern Spain is giving scientists a rare look at the skin, soft tissues, and possible coloration of an ancient crocodile relative that lived about 125 million years ago.

The new study, published in the Zoological Journal of the Linnean Society , provides the first detailed description of soft tissues preserved in Montsecosuchus depereti , a Lower Cretaceous crocodylomorph discovered at the Pedrera de Meià site in the province of Lleida (Catalonia, Spain). By examining the fossil under ultraviolet light, researchers uncovered new evidence about its skin, sensory structures, respiratory anatomy, and possible color pattern. The work was led by the Institut Català de Paleontologia Miquel Crusafont.

Approximately 125 million years ago, a small crocodile died in a karstic lake close to the coast of what is now the Catalan Pre-Pyrenees. Its body settled into fine lake sediments, where unusually favorable conditions helped preserve it in exceptional detail. Over time, those sediments became the lithographic limestones of the Pedrera de Meià, now part of the UNESCO Orígens Global Geopark.

The fossil, cataloged as MGB-512, is about 50 centimeters long and is housed at the Museum of Natural Sciences of Barcelona. It was discovered more than a century ago and received some scientific attention in the 90s, but researchers have now extracted information that had remained hidden since its discovery, including the shape and distribution of its preserved soft tissues.

The breakthrough came while paleontologists Oscar Castillo and Jesús Serrano were building a database of fossils from the lithographic limestones of Montsec held in Catalan and European museums. When they examined the holotype of Montsecosuchus depereti under ultraviolet light, they noticed structures that appeared to be remnants of soft tissue.

Ultraviolet light can cause fossilized tissues and the surrounding rock to respond differently, making otherwise invisible structures stand out.

"UV light allows us to see details that would otherwise remain completely hidden in the rock," explains Oscar Castillo-Visa, first author of the work.

Using this technique, the team documented several kinds of soft tissue, including epidermal scales. Although Montsecosuchus depereti has been known to science since the early 20th century, the new analysis provides the first detailed picture of what its skin looked like.

The scales varied considerably in shape and size across different parts of the body. The researchers also found that the animal lacked the high caudal fin seen in modern crocodiles.

The fossil may also preserve evidence of sensory organs in the skin. The possible structures appear within some scales, particularly around...
body.zh: 西班牙东北部的一块保存完好的化石让科学家们得以罕见地观察生活在大约 1.25 亿年前的远古鳄鱼亲戚的皮肤、软组织和可能的颜色。 这项发表在《林奈学会动物学杂志》上的新研究首次详细描述了 Montsecosuchus depereti 中保存的软组织，Montsecosuchus depereti 是在莱里达省（西班牙加泰罗尼亚）的 Pedrera de Meià 遗址发现的一种下白垩纪鳄鱼型。通过在紫外线下检查化石，研究人员发现了有关其皮肤、感觉结构、呼吸解剖结构和可能的颜色模式的新证据。这项工作由加泰罗尼亚古生物学研究所 Miquel Crusafont 领导。 大约 1.25 亿年前，一只小鳄鱼死在靠近现在加泰罗尼亚前比利牛斯山脉海岸的喀斯特湖中。它的身体沉入了细小的湖泊沉积物中，异常有利的条件帮助它保存了异常的细节。随着时间的推移，这些沉积物变成了 Pedrera de Meià 的平版石灰岩，现在是联合国教科文组织奥利根世界地质公园的一部分。 这块化石编号为 MGB-512，长约 50 厘米，现藏于巴塞罗那自然科学博物馆。它在一个多世纪前被发现，并在 90 年代受到了一些科学关注，但研究人员现在提取了自发现以来一直隐藏的信息，包括其保存的软组织的形状和分布。 这一突破是在古生物学家奥斯卡·卡斯蒂略（Oscar Castillo）和赫苏斯·塞拉诺（Jesús Serrano）建立加泰罗尼亚和欧洲博物馆收藏的蒙特塞克石版石灰岩化石数据库时实现的。当他们在紫外线下检查 Montsecosuchus depereti 的正模标本时，他们注意到似乎是软组织残留物的结构。 紫外线会导致化石组织和周围的岩石产生不同的反应，使原本看不见的结构脱颖而出。 该作品的第一作者 Oscar Castillo-Visa 解释道：“紫外线使我们能够看到原本完全隐藏在岩石中的细节。” 使用这种技术，研究小组记录了几种软组织，包括表皮鳞片。尽管德佩雷蒂山鳄自 20 世纪初就为科学所熟知，但新的分析首次提供了其皮肤外观的详细图片。 身体不同部位的鳞片的形状和大小差异很大。研究人员还发现，这种动物缺乏现代鳄鱼所具有的高尾鳍。 该化石还可能保存了皮肤感觉器官的证据。可能的结构出现在某些尺度内，特别是在......

reflection.en: The intricate patterns on the tail of this ancient crocodile, invisible until revealed by scientific tools, remind us that the created world holds many wonders. Job 12:7-9 encourages us to ask the animals and birds, the fish and the earth, for they all teach us about Yahweh's wisdom and design.
reflection.zh: 这只古代鳄鱼尾部复杂的图案，直到被科学工具揭示才显现，提醒我们受造的世界蕴藏着许多奇迹。约伯记12:7-9鼓励我们去问动物、飞鸟、鱼和大地，因为它们都教导我们关于雅伟的智慧和设计。

verse.textEn: But ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds in the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish in the sea inform you.
verse.textZh: 你且问走兽，走兽必指教你；又问空中的飞鸟，飞鸟必告诉你。或与地说话，地必指教你；海中的鱼也必向你说明。

title.en: The shape behind the Einstein problem just revealed strange new physics
title.zh: 爱因斯坦问题背后的形状揭示了奇异的新物理学

summary.en: A mathematical shape, known for solving a long-standing puzzle, has demonstrated an unexpected ability to manipulate light into unique chiral patterns. This finding may pave the way for novel methods of controlling light and polarization, leading to advancements in optical devices.
summary.zh: 一种以解决长期存在的数学难题而闻名的数学形状，现已展现出将光扭曲成独特手性模式的意外能力。这一发现可能为控制光和偏振的新方法铺平道路，从而推动光学器件的进步。

body.en:
A mathematical shape that drew global attention for solving a decades-old puzzle is now revealing an unexpected connection to physics. Researchers have found that structures based on the shape can make light form unusual chiral patterns, pointing to new ways of exploring how geometry can influence optical behavior.

In a study published in Nature Communications , researchers from the Institute of Industrial Science, The University of Tokyo, and collaborating institutions built optical structures inspired by the "Smith hat." This unusual shape is known for solving the so-called Einstein problem in mathematics. When the team illuminated the structures with laser light, they observed diffraction effects unlike those seen in conventional quasicrystals.

The Einstein problem asks whether a single tile shape, known as a "monotile," can cover an entire surface without creating a repeating pattern.

Familiar tilings such as checkerboards and honeycombs repeat in a regular way. An aperiodic monotile, by contrast, can fill a surface without ever settling into a repeating arrangement.

In 2023, researchers discovered the first such monotile, the Smith hat. The finding attracted widespread attention because it provided a long-sought solution to the mathematical problem.

"What is especially fascinating about the hat tile is that, although the resulting pattern appears irregular at first glance, it is actually constructed from the honeycomb lattice," says lead author Yuto Moritake. "We wanted to see whether this unique shape could also produce any unexpected physical phenomena."

To test that possibility, the researchers created nanoscale versions of the pattern on silicon nitride films using electron beam lithography.

When laser light was directed at the structures, the resulting diffraction patterns formed distinctive pinwheel-like shapes. These patterns directly revealed the chiral character of the aperiodic structure.

Chirality refers to a form of handedness in which a structure and its mirror image cannot be perfectly matched. In this case, the unusual arrangement of the monotile pattern caused the light itself to display a chiral response.

"We found that the diffraction patterns themselves become chiral because the structure lacks mirror symmetry," explains senior author Masaya Notomi. "This kind of optical response is fundamentally different from that observed in conventional quasicrystalline materials."

The researchers also found that the diffraction pattern changed depending on both the direction and polarization of the incoming light.

When the physical structures were mirrored, their optical behavior reversed as well. This showed that the response of the light was directly tied to the symmetry of the underlying pattern, revealing a new type of...
body.zh: 一个因解决数十年之久的难题而引起全球关注的数学形状现在揭示了与物理学的意想不到的联系。研究人员发现，基于形状的结构可以使光形成不寻常的手性图案，这为探索几何形状如何影响光学行为提供了新方法。 在《自然通讯》杂志上发表的一项研究中，东京大学工业科学研究所和合作机构的研究人员受“史密斯帽”的启发，构建了光学结构。这种不寻常的形状因解决数学中所谓的爱因斯坦问题而闻名。当研究小组用激光照射这些结构时，他们观察到了与传统准晶体不同的衍射效应。 爱因斯坦问题询问单个瓦片形状（称为“单片”）是否可以覆盖整个表面而不产生重复图案。 棋盘格和蜂窝等熟悉的瓷砖以有规律的方式重复。相比之下，非周期性单块可以填充表面，而无需陷入重复排列。 2023 年，研究人员发现了第一个这样的单片——史密斯帽。这一发现引起了广泛关注，因为它为这个数学问题提供了长期寻求的解决方案。 “帽子瓷砖特别令人着迷的是，虽然最终的图案乍一看似乎不规则，但它实际上是由蜂窝格子构成的，”主要作者 Yuto Moritake 说。 “我们想看看这种独特的形状是否也能产生任何意想不到的物理现象。” 为了测试这种可能性，研究人员使用电子束光刻在氮化硅薄膜上创建了纳米级版本的图案。 当激光照射到结构上时，产生的衍射图案形成独特的风车状形状。这些图案直接揭示了非周期结构的手性特征。 手性是指结构与其镜像无法完美匹配的一种旋手性形式。在这种情况下，单块图案的不寻常排列导致光本身显示出手性响应。 “我们发现衍射图案本身变得手性，因为结构缺乏镜像对称性，”资深作者 Masaya Notomi 解释道。 “这种光学响应与传统准晶材料中观察到的光学响应根本不同。” 研究人员还发现，衍射图案的变化取决于入射光的方向和偏振。 当物理结构被镜像时，它们的光学行为也会发生逆转。这表明光的响应与底层图案的对称性直接相关，揭示了一种新型的……

reflection.en: The universe operates according to deep, underlying principles, often revealed through the patient work of scientists. The discovery that a mathematical shape, the 'Smith hat,' can influence light in novel ways reminds us that Yahweh's creation is intricately ordered, with laws that govern even the behavior of light. This pursuit of understanding the cosmos...
reflection.zh: 宇宙遵循着深刻的、潜在的原理运行，这些原理常常通过科学家们耐心而艰辛的工作得以揭示。‘史密斯帽’这一数学形状能够以新颖的方式影响光线的发现，提醒我们雅伟所造的宇宙是精心有序的，其法则甚至支配着光的行为。这种对宇宙的理解探索，反映了人类深刻的好奇心，并呼应着维系万物的深刻秩序。

verse.textEn: He is before all things, and in him all things hold together.
verse.textZh: 他在万有之先；万有也靠他而立。

title.en: US confirms for first time it has deployed weapons in space
title.zh: 美国首次确认已部署太空武器

summary.en: The US military has confirmed the deployment of weapons in space, a move that analysts warn could escalate a high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth's orbit. The confirmation comes from the US Air Force Secretary, who stated that "on-orbit" weapons are now active and circling the globe.
summary.zh: 美国军方已确认在太空部署了武器，分析人士警告此举可能加剧与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛。美国空军部长证实了这一消息，并表示“在轨”武器已处于活动状态并绕地球运行。

body.en: Analysts warn of an acceleration in high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth’s orbit The US has deployed weapons in space, the US military has confirmed, in an extraordinary public announcement that analysts warn will accelerate a high-risk arms race with Russia and China in Earth’s orbit. The US secretary of the air force, Troy Meink, said Washington had active “on-orbit” weapons, meaning they had been deployed and were circling the globe. Continue reading...
body.zh: 分析人士警告称，与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛将加速美国军方在一份非同寻常的公开声明中证实，美国已在太空部署武器，分析人士警告称，这将加速与俄罗斯和中国在地球轨道上的高风险军备竞赛。美国空军部长特洛伊·梅因克表示，华盛顿拥有活跃的“在轨”武器，这意味着它们已经部署并正在环绕地球飞行。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The confirmation of weapons in space is a sobering development, highlighting humanity's persistent drive to weaponize new frontiers. Isaiah's vision of a world where nations 'beat their swords into plowshares' offers a stark contrast to this trajectory. May we pray for wisdom and restraint among global powers, that the pursuit of security does not lead to...
reflection.zh: 在太空部署武器的确认是一个令人警醒的发展，凸显了人类将新领域武器化的持续驱动力。以赛亚关于世界各国“将刀打成犁头”的异象与这一轨迹形成了鲜明对比。愿我们为全球大国祈求智慧和克制，使对安全的追求不至于导致相互毁灭。

verse.textEn: They will beat their swords into plowshares and their spears into pruning hooks.
verse.textZh: 他们要将刀打成犁头，把枪打成镰刀。

title.en: Data centre could threaten rare species, says charity
title.zh: 数据中心可能威胁稀有物种，慈善机构称

summary.en: The Essex Wildlife Trust warns that the construction of a new data centre could lead to the destruction of incredibly rare habitats, threatening endangered plants and a rare species of bumblebee.
summary.zh: 埃塞克斯野生动物信托基金警告称，新建数据中心的计划可能会导致极其罕见的栖息地被摧毁，威胁到濒危植物和一种稀有的熊蜂。

body.en:
Plans to build a new data centre could threaten the habitat of one of Britain's most endangered plants and a rare species of bumblebee, a wildlife trust said.

A planning application has already been submitted for the Google data centre at Arena Essex Raceway in Thurrock, which is designated as a local wildlife site.

It is home to the rare broad-leaved cudweed and shrill carder bumblebee and the Essex Wildlife Trust fears "incredibly rare" habitats would be "destroyed".

A Google spokesperson said it took "our environmental responsibilities very seriously".

Data centres are giant warehouses full of powerful computers used to run digital services, such as movie streaming, online banking and artificial intelligence.

There are 568 data centres listed in the UK, according to the data centre map. , external

Emily Buttress, from the Essex Wildlife Trust, said her team was worried about the water and energy usage required, the warming effect on the surrounding land, and a lack of research about the long-term impacts of these buildings.

"What would it do for the local community in a water drought county? We are not against development, but it has to happen sustainably."

The Arena Essex Raceway announced in 2018 that it would stop hosting speedway fixtures for the Lakeside Hammers team.

Meanwhile, the Essex Wildlife Trust says the surrounding grassland and woodland has become home to 687 invertebrate and 439 plant species.

The trust said this included dingy skipper, which is a small moth-like butterfly, and the shrill carder bumblebee, which was only found in two areas in England.

It was designated as a local wildlife site in 2006. This does not offer legal protection from development, but it means council planners expect developers to look after the ecology.

Nightingale birds, the brown-banded carder bee and the five-banded weevil-wasp have also been recorded at the site.

But Global Infrastructure UK Limited bought the 129-acre (52-hectare) site in July 2023 for £47m (exclusive of VAT).

It submitted plans for the data centre on behalf of Google last year, and as part of the application, consultancy firm Mallory Land Ltd said the proposals took into account the ecology there.

In a statement submitted as part of the plans, Mallory Land Ltd said: "The demand for data centres has expanded significantly in recent years, driven by exponential growth in digital services, the emergence of artificial intelligence, cloud-based technologies, and the increasing adoption of smart infrastructure."

"We share the Essex Wildlife Trust and Buglife's , external view that development at the former Arena Essex site must be sustainable," a spokesperson said.

"Our goal is to regenerate the site, bringing long-term investment and jobs to Thurrock while taking our...
body.zh: 野生动物信托基金表示，建设新数据中心的计划可能会威胁英国最濒危植物之一和稀有熊蜂物种的栖息地。 位于瑟罗克埃塞克斯赛道的谷歌数据中心的规划申请已经提交，该数据中心被指定为当地野生动物保护区。 它是罕见的阔叶杂草和尖锐的大黄蜂的家园，埃塞克斯野生动物信托基金担心“极其罕见”的栖息地将被“摧毁”。 谷歌发言人表示，该公司“非常重视我们的环境责任”。 数据中心是巨大的仓库，里面装满了用于运行电影流、在线银行和人工智能等数字服务的强大计算机。 根据数据中心地图，英国列出了 568 个数据中心。 , 外部 埃塞克斯野生动物信托基金会的艾米丽·巴特雷斯表示，她的团队担心所需的水和能源使用、对周围土地的变暖影响以及缺乏对这些建筑物的长期影响的研究。 “这对缺水县的当地社区有什么作用？我们并不反对发展，但它必须可持续发展。” 埃塞克斯竞技场赛道 (Arena Essex Raceway) 于 2018 年宣布，将停止为湖滨铁锤队 (Lakeside Hammers) 举办赛道比赛。 与此同时，埃塞克斯野生动物信托基金会表示，周围的草原和林地已成为 687 种无脊椎动物和 439 种植物的家园。 该信托基金表示，其中包括暗色船长（一种像飞蛾一样的小蝴蝶）和尖声卡德大黄蜂（仅在英格兰的两个地区发现）。 它于 2006 年被指定为当地野生动物保护区。这并没有提供开发方面的法律保护，但这意味着议会规划者希望开发商能够照顾好生态。 该地点还记录了夜莺、棕带梳理蜂和五带象甲黄蜂。 但全球基础设施英国有限公司于 2023 年 7 月以 4700 万英镑（不含增值税）购买了这片 129 英亩（52 公顷）的土地。 去年，它代表谷歌提交了数据中心的计划，作为申请的一部分，咨询公司 Mallory Land Ltd 表示，这些建议考虑了那里的生态。 Mallory Land Ltd 在作为计划一部分提交的声明中表示：“近年来，在数字服务呈指数级增长、人工智能、云技术的出现以及智能基础设施日益普及的推动下，对数据中心的需求显着扩大。” 一位发言人表示：“我们同意埃塞克斯野生动物信托基金和 Buglife 的外部观点，即前埃塞克斯竞技场场地的开发必须是可持续的。” “我们的目标是重建该地点，为瑟罗克带来长期投资和就业机会，同时...

reflection.en: The news of a proposed data centre in Thurrock raises concerns about the potential loss of unique habitats, home to endangered species like the broad-leaved cudweed and shrill carder bumblebee. The Psalmist marvels at the diversity of life, declaring, "How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures." This...
reflection.zh: 位于瑟罗克的拟议数据中心的新闻引发了对独特栖息地可能丧失的担忧，那里是宽叶鼠耳草和尖声绒毛熊蜂等濒危物种的家园。诗篇作者惊叹于生命的丰富多样，宣告说：“雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！万物都凭你的智慧造了；全地充满了你的造物。”这提醒我们所有受造物固有的复杂之美和价值，在开发影响自然世界时，敦促我们仔细权衡。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: No, collagen won’t make your wrinkles disappear - video
title.zh: 不，胶原蛋白不会让你的皱纹消失 - 视频

summary.en: Collagen powders, gummies, and pills have surged in popularity, fueled by claims of smoothing wrinkles, promoting hair growth, and alleviating joint pain. Amidst this marketing noise, it's challenging to discern the scientific basis for promises of extended youthfulness. Dr. Xand van Tulleken, in his book 'Make Me...
summary.zh: 胶原蛋白粉、软糖和药丸近年来销量激增，其宣传声称可以抚平皱纹、促进头发健康并缓解关节疼痛。在这些喧嚣的宣传中，很难弄清楚这些关于延缓衰老的承诺背后是否有真正的科学依据。Xand van Tulleken...

body.en: Collagen powders, gummies and pills have boomed in popularity in recent years boosted by claims that they smooth wrinkles, promote glossy hair and help with joint pain. Amid the noise it can be hard to figure out whether there’s any actual science behind the promise of looking younger for longer. Luckily Dr Xand van Tulleken has spent the past three years writing Make me well: a quest to understand the confusing world of wellness , and his chapter on collagen dives deep into the evidence. He tells Madeleine Finlay what collagen does in the body, how we can get it without splashing out on expensive supplements, and why getting to the truth behind wellness claims can be so hard Continue reading...
body.zh: 近年来，胶原蛋白粉、软糖和药丸迅速流行起来，因为它们声称可以抚平皱纹、促进头发光泽并有助于缓解关节疼痛。在喧嚣声中，很难弄清楚让自己看起来更年轻的承诺背后是否有真正的科学依据。幸运的是，Xand van Tulleken 博士在过去三年里一直在撰写《让我康复：寻求理解令人困惑的健康世界》一书，他关于胶原蛋白的章节深入探讨了证据。他告诉玛德琳芬利胶原蛋白在体内的作用，我们如何在不花昂贵的补充剂的情况下获得胶原蛋白，以及为什么了解健康声明背后的真相如此困难继续阅读...

reflection.en: In a world saturated with wellness trends and marketing claims, it's easy to feel overwhelmed and unsure of what to believe. The pursuit of looking younger and healthier is understandable, but the noise surrounding supplements like collagen can obscure the truth. Philippians 4:8 reminds us to focus our minds on what is true, noble, right, pure, lovely, and...
reflection.zh: 在一个充斥着健康潮流和营销宣传的世界里，人们很容易感到不知所措，不知道该相信什么。追求看起来更年轻、更健康是可以理解的，但围绕胶原蛋白等补充剂的喧嚣可能会掩盖真相。腓立比书 4:8 提醒我们要将心思意念集中在真实、可敬、公义、清洁、可爱、有美名的事上，鼓励我们在困惑中保持分辨力。

verse.textEn: Whatever is true, whatever is noble, whatever is right, whatever is pure, whatever is lovely, whatever is admirable — think about such things.
verse.textZh: 凡是真实的、可敬的、公义的、清洁的、可爱的、有美名的，这些事你们都要思念。

title.en: Will El Niño bring winter snow to the UK?
title.zh: 厄尔尼诺会给英国带来冬季降雪吗？

summary.en: Meteorologist Matt Taylor provides a forecast for the upcoming autumn and winter months in the UK, considering the potential influence of the El Niño phenomenon on weather patterns, specifically snow.
summary.zh: 气象学家马特·泰勒展望了英国的秋冬季节，并探讨了厄尔尼诺现象对降雪可能产生的影响。

reflection.en: The changing weather patterns, influenced by phenomena like El Niño, remind us of the intricate systems governing our planet. The Psalmist marvels, 'How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.' (Psalm 104:24). We can find wonder in observing these natural cycles, recognizing the Creator's hand in the...
reflection.zh: 像厄尔尼诺这样的现象所带来的天气变化，提醒我们地球上运行着多么精密的系统。诗篇作者惊叹道：“雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！万物都凭你的智慧造了；全地充满了你的创造物。”（诗篇104:24）。我们可以在观察这些自然循环中找到惊奇，认识到造物主在我们世界微妙平衡中的手。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: They’re the sopranos of the forest, so what’s silencing the gibbons’ morning chorus?
title.zh: 森林里的女高音们，是什么让长臂猿的晨曲沉默了？

summary.en: As human development and roads increasingly fragment their habitats, a study suggests traffic noise could be altering the animals’ wake-up call. Dawn has broken, and the air is cool and still. It’s at about this time that gibbons usually erupt into song, wa-oo-ing and wa-ing from the highest branches and filling the...
summary.zh: 随着人类开发和道路日益分割它们的栖息地，一项研究表明交通噪音可能正在改变动物的唤醒曲。黎明破晓，空气凉爽而宁静。大约在这个时候，长臂猿通常会放声歌唱，从最高的树枝上发出哇呜哇呜的叫声，用丰富的旋律填满树冠。但在马来西亚这片被房屋和道路包围的森林角落里，居住的白手长臂猿却沉默着。唯一能听到的只有附近高速公路传来的交通噪音...

body.en: As human development and roads increasingly fragment their habitats, a study suggests traffic noise could be altering the animals’ wake-up call Dawn has broken, and the air is cool and still. It’s at about this time that gibbons usually erupt into song, wa-oo-ing and wa-ing from the highest branches and filling the tree tops with rich melodies. But in this corner of Malaysian forest, bordered by housing and roads, the resident white-handed gibbons are quiet. All that can be heard is the hum of traffic from a nearby highway. This isn’t a rare occurrence for this group of gibbons, according to research, which found these particular gibbons, named Mambang and Walinong, appeared to be producing far fewer morning songs than others that are not exposed to the same level of traffic noise. Continue reading...
body.zh: 随着人类发展和道路日益破碎它们的栖息地，一项研究表明，交通噪音可能会改变动物的叫醒声黎明已经破晓，空气凉爽而宁静。大约在这个时候，长臂猿通常会从最高的树枝上发出呜呜呜的歌声，让树顶充满丰富的旋律。但在马来西亚森林的这个角落，毗邻房屋和道路，居住的白掌长臂猿却很安静。只能听到附近高速公路传来的交通声。根据研究，这种情况对于这群长臂猿来说并不罕见，研究发现这些特殊的长臂猿，名为曼邦（Mambang）和瓦利农（Walinong），与其他没有暴露在同等交通噪音水平下的长臂猿相比，早上发出的歌曲似乎要少得多。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The vibrant chorus of gibbons, once a hallmark of the dawn, is being muted by the pervasive noise of human activity. This silencing is a poignant echo of the groaning of creation, as described in Romans 8:22, which suffers under the weight of our development. May we listen to these subtle cries and seek ways to live more harmoniously with the natural world.
reflection.zh: 长臂猿充满活力的合唱曾是黎明的标志，如今却被人类活动无处不在的噪音所压制。这种沉默是罗马书8:22中所描述的受造之物的叹息的凄美回响，它们承受着我们发展的重负。愿我们倾听这些细微的呼唤，并寻求与自然世界更和谐地相处之道。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Ebola outbreak in DRC has peaked, say authorities, as infection rates slow
title.zh: 刚果（金）当局称埃博拉疫情已达顶峰，感染率放缓

summary.en: Authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have announced that the Ebola outbreak ravaging parts of the country has reached its peak. For the first time since the epidemic was declared in May, the numbers of people becoming infected is slowing down, according to officials. Strict adherence to preventive...
summary.zh: 刚果（民主共和国）当局宣布，肆虐该国部分地区埃博拉疫情已达到顶峰。官员们表示，自5月宣布疫情以来，首次出现感染人数放缓的迹象。刚果卫生部长塞缪尔·罗杰·坎巴强调，必须严格遵守预防措施，并指出邦迪布吉约变种埃博拉的传播有所下降。

body.en:
About this content Prosper Heri Ngorora in Goma Tue 15 Sep 2026 00.00 EDT Last modified on Tue 15 Sep 2026 14.54 EDT Share Prefer the Guardian on Google Authorities in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have announced that the Ebola outbreak ravaging parts of the country has reached its peak.

For the first time since the epidemic was declared in May, the numbers of people becoming infected is slowing down, according to officials.

Stressing that strict adherence to preventive measures needed to be kept in place, Samuel Roger Kamba, the Congolese health minister, said there was a decline in transmission of the Bundibugyo variant of Ebola .

“We are fighting a very dangerous virus that is killing many of our people. Today, we can say that the outbreak is under control,” he said. “At one point, we were recording about 120 cases per day; today, we’re seeing about 80 per day. So the number of new cases is decreasing every day.

“It has been more than 22 days since 10 of the 62 health zones have reported new cases. And so we can now definitively remove six health zones from the list because they have gone more than 42 days without new cases, and we can remove four health zones that have gone more than 21 days without a new case,” Kamba said.

Last week, the Sud-Ubangi region, on the DRC’s borders with Congo-Brazzaville and Central African Republic, became the sixth province to report the disease.

The Bundibugyo virus outbreak was declared by Congolese authorities on 15 May and is concentrated primarily in Ituri province, where ongoing conflict has created challenging conditions for those responding to the disease. It is the 17th outbreak of Ebola in the DRC since the highly contagious disease was first identified and named in 1976.

No effective treatment for the Bundibugyo variant has been found so far but there are clinical trials in the region. The DRC received more than 70,000 doses of the Ervebo vaccine last month, which is the only approved treatment for the more common Zaire Ebola virus.

According to the latest data from the Congolese health ministry, the number of confirmed cases stood at more than 7,200, including more than 3,475 deaths , as of 14 September.

While welcoming the progress made, Iracan Gratien de Saint-Nicolas, an MP for Bunia, warned against what he called “triumphalism” and stressed that efforts must intensify to show people that the disease was under control.

Gratien Iracan called for lessons to be learned from failures in epidemiological surveillance that contributed to the rapid spread of the disease.

The MP also expressed some scepticism over the government announcement. “Claims that an epidemic is under control must be supported by objective indicators. If the indicators show that the epidemic is indeed under control,...
body.zh: 关于此内容 戈马的 Prosper Heri Ngorora 2026 年 9 月 15 日星期二 00.00 EDT 最后修改时间 2026 年 9 月 15 日星期二 14.54 EDT 分享 更喜欢 Google 上的卫报 刚果民主共和国当局宣布，肆虐该国部分地区的埃博拉疫情已达到顶峰。 官员称，自五月宣布疫情以来，感染人数首次放缓。 刚果卫生部长塞缪尔·罗杰·坎巴强调，必须严格遵守预防措施，并表示本迪布焦变种埃博拉病毒的传播有所减少。 “我们正在对抗一种非常危险的病毒，它正在夺走我们许多人的生命。今天，我们可以说疫情已得到控制，”他说。 “曾经，我们每天记录约 120 例病例；今天，我们每天记录约 80 例。因此，新病例数量每天都在减少。 “62个卫生区中有10个报告新病例已经过去22天多了。因此，我们现在可以明确地将 6 个卫生区从名单中删除，因为它们已经超过 42 天没有出现新病例，我们可以删除 4 个已经超过 21 天没有新病例的卫生区，”坎巴说。 上周，位于刚果民主共和国与刚果-布拉柴维尔和中非共和国接壤的南乌班吉地区成为报告这种疾病的第六个省份。 刚果当局于 5 月 15 日宣布本迪布焦病毒爆发，主要集中在伊图里省，该省持续的冲突给应对该疾病的人员带来了挑战性的条件。这是自 1976 年首次发现并命名埃博拉这种高度传染性疾病以来，刚果民主共和国爆发的第 17 次埃博拉疫情。 迄今为止，尚未发现针对 Bundibugyo 变种的有效治疗方法，但该地区已有临床试验。刚果民主共和国上个月接收了超过 70,000 剂 Ervebo 疫苗，这是针对更常见的扎伊尔埃博拉病毒的唯一获批治疗方法。 根据刚果卫生部的最新数据，截至9月14日，确诊病例已超过7,200例，其中死亡病例超过3,475例。 布尼亚议员伊拉坎·格拉蒂安·德·圣尼古拉斯在欢迎所取得的进展的同时，警告不要出现他所谓的“必胜主义”，并强调必须加大努力，向人们表明这种疾病已得到控制。 格拉蒂恩·伊拉坎（Gratien Iracan）呼吁从导致疾病迅速传播的流行病学监测失败中汲取教训。 这位议员还对政府的声明表示了一些怀疑。 “声称疫情已得到控制必须有客观指标的支持。如果各项指标表明疫情确实得到控制的话……

reflection.en: After months of devastating loss, news from the Democratic Republic of the Congo offers a glimmer of hope: the Ebola outbreak appears to have peaked. While the nearly 3,500 lives lost are a profound tragedy, the slowing infection rates signal a turning point. This news echoes the ancient lament, 'The steadfast love of Yahweh never ceases; his mercies never...
reflection.zh: 在经历了数月的毁灭性损失后，来自刚果（民主共和国）的消息带来了一线希望：埃博拉疫情似乎已达到顶峰。尽管近3500人的死亡是一个深刻的悲剧，但感染率的放缓预示着一个转折点。这一消息呼应了古老的哀歌：“雅伟的慈爱永不枯竭，他的怜悯永不穷尽，每日早晨都是新的；你的信实何等广大。”即使面对持续的危机，缓解和复兴的可能性也证明了永恒的信实。

verse.textEn: Because of Yahweh's great love we are not consumed, for his compassions never fail. They are new every morning.
verse.textZh: 我们不至消灭，是出于雅伟诸般的慈爱；是因他的怜悯不至断绝。每早晨这都是新的。

title.zh: 通过RNF213直接泛素化调控糖原质量

summary.en: A study published in Nature details how the enzyme RNF213 directly ubiquitylation controls the quality of glycogen, a key energy storage molecule. This discovery sheds light on cellular quality control mechanisms.
summary.zh: 发表在《自然》杂志上的一项研究详细介绍了酶RNF213如何通过直接泛素化来控制糖原（一种关键的能量储存分子）的质量。这一发现阐明了细胞质量控制机制。

reflection.en: The intricate processes within our cells, like the quality control of glycogen described in this study, reveal the profound wisdom embedded in creation. As Job 12:7-9 reminds us, 'Ask the animals, and they will teach you, or the birds of the sky, and they will tell you; or speak to the earth, and it will teach you, or let the fish of the sea inform you.'...
reflection.zh: 我们细胞内复杂的生化过程，例如本研究中描述的糖原质量控制，揭示了创造中蕴含的深刻智慧。正如约伯书12:7-9所提醒我们的：“你可以问走兽，它们会教导你；天空的飞鸟，它们会告诉你；或对大地说话，它会教导你；海中的鱼也会告诉你。” 自然界，直至分子层面，都是雅伟设计的明证，也是深刻理解的源泉。

reflection.en: The scientific community constantly refines its understanding, as seen in this correction. It reminds us that diligent observation and study of the natural world, as Job 12:7 suggests, can reveal profound truths about its intricate workings. Even as knowledge advances, humility and a commitment to accuracy are essential.
reflection.zh: 科学界不断完善其理解，正如这次勘误所示。它提醒我们，正如约伯记12:7所建议的，勤奋地观察和研究自然世界，可以揭示其错综复杂运作的深刻真理。即使知识在进步，谦逊和对准确性的承诺也是必不可少的。

reflection.en: This editorial calls for a broader distribution of research funding worldwide, recognizing that diverse perspectives and locations are crucial for scientific advancement. The ancient wisdom of Job reminds us that creation itself is a source of profound understanding, urging us to look closely at the world around us, wherever we are, to uncover its secrets....
reflection.zh: 这篇社论呼吁在全球范围内更广泛地分配研究经费，认识到多元化的视角和地点对于科学进步至关重要。《约伯记》中的古老智慧提醒我们，创造本身就是深刻理解的源泉，敦促我们无论身在何处，都要仔细观察周围的世界，以揭示其奥秘。愿我们支持并鼓励来自世界各个角落的知识追求。

summary.en: Despite satellite warnings of impending floods, Nepal experienced a disaster, indicating a gap between scientific observation and effective disaster response.
summary.zh: 尽管卫星预警了即将到来的洪水，尼泊尔却遭受了灾难，这表明科学观测与有效的灾害应对之间存在差距。

reflection.en: The vastness and complexity of creation, as Psalm 104:24 reminds us, hold immense wisdom. Even with advanced tools like satellites, understanding and acting upon the warnings from nature's intricate systems remains a profound challenge for humanity.
reflection.zh: 正如诗篇104:24所提醒我们的，创造的浩瀚与复杂蕴含着无比的智慧。即使拥有卫星等先进工具，理解并应对来自自然复杂系统的警示，对人类而言仍是一个深刻的挑战。
