title.en: Blanche defends Trump’s tirade against supreme court after it blocked mail-in voting executive order – US politics live
title.zh: 特朗普抨击阻止邮寄投票行政命令的决定：“这个法院真的让我们的国家失望了”——直播

summary.en: The president called mail-in voting – which he has used on several occasions to cast a ballot – ‘a laughing stock’ across the world. The Supreme Court has rejected Trump’s mail ballot restrictions for midterm elections. Kash Patel, the FBI director, is now testifying before lawmakers on the Senate judiciary committee.
summary.zh: 总统称邮寄投票——他本人曾多次使用邮寄投票——是全世界的“笑柄”。最高法院驳回了特朗普对中期选举的邮寄选票限制。联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔目前正在参议院司法委员会就此向议员们作证。

body.en: Attorney general says president ‘should communicate his concerns with the supreme court’ after Trump said justices ‘really let our country down’ Sign up for US Breaking News emails Kash Patel , the FBI director, is now testifying before lawmakers on the Senate judiciary committee. A reminder that the last time he appeared before Congress was in May, when he sparred with senators on the appropriations committee and denied – under oath – allegations of excessive drinking and unexplained absences on the job, dismissing them as “baseless” during a fiery congressional hearing. Today’s hearing is also expected to be full of heated exchanges. “Mr Patel is the least qualified and most partisan FBI director in our nation’s history,” said Senator Dick Durbin, the judiciary committee’s top Democrat. “The bureau has been reshaped as a political weapon against President Trump’s political enemies and a shield to protect the president and his MAGA loyalists, not the American people.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 总统称邮寄投票——他曾多次使用这种方式进行投票——在全世界都是“笑柄”。最高法院驳回了特朗普对中期选举的邮寄选票限制。联邦调查局局长卡什·帕特尔目前正在参议院司法委员会的议员面前作证。提醒人们，他最后一次出现在国会是在五月份，当时他与拨款委员会的参议员发生争执，并在宣誓后否认了有关过度饮酒和不明原因缺勤的指控，并在一场激烈的国会听证会上驳斥称这些指控“毫无根据”。今天的听证会预计也会充满激烈的交流。 “帕特尔先生是我们国家历史上最不合格、最具党派倾向的联邦调查局局长，”司法委员会民主党领袖、参议员迪克·杜宾(Dick Durbin)说。 “该局已被重塑为对抗特朗普总统政敌的政治武器，以及保护总统和他的 MAGA 忠诚者而不是美国人民的盾牌。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The Supreme Court's rejection of mail-in voting restrictions, despite the president's strong objections, underscores the principle that legal processes often require hearing multiple perspectives. Proverbs 18:17 reminds us that even in disputes, there is value in listening to each party before rendering a verdict, a principle crucial for maintaining trust...
reflection.zh: 最高法院驳回了对邮寄投票的限制，尽管总统对此表示强烈反对，这凸显了法律程序通常需要听取多方观点的原则。箴言18:17提醒我们，即使在争端中，在做出裁决之前听取各方陈述也是有价值的，这一原则对于维护机构的信任至关重要。

verse.textEn: In a lawsuit the first to speak seems right, until someone comes forward and cross-examines.
verse.textZh: 先诉情由的，似乎有理；但邻舍来到，就察出实情。

title.en: Nvidia boss says AI 'doesn't need new laws' as safety concerns grow
title.zh: 英伟达CEO称AI“不需要新法律” 安全担忧日益加剧

summary.en: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang stated that artificial intelligence (AI) does not require new laws, even as concerns about its potential threats to humanity grow. He believes that AI companies themselves should decide when to release new versions of the technology, arguing against a perceived trade-off between innovation...
summary.zh: 英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋表示，尽管对人工智能（AI）可能对人类构成的威胁的担忧日益加剧，但人工智能并不需要新的法律。他认为人工智能公司本身应该决定何时发布新版本技术，并反对在创新速度和产品安全之间做出“虚假选择”。这一立场与一些业内人士的担忧形成对比，他们担心人工智能可能带来生存风险。

body.en:
The heads of artificial intelligence (AI) firms should decide if new versions of the technology should be released, Nvidia boss Jensen Huang has said in response to growing concerns about AI's threat to humans.

"We don't need new laws or regulations," Huang said, adding that there should not be a "false choice" between the speed of innovation and the safety of AI products.

Nvidia is the biggest company in the world by valuation, with its profits having boomed as a result of rampant demand for the AI computing chips it makes.

Huang's stance on AI safety contrasts with those in the industry who have recently expressed fears that the technology could wipe out humanity.

A post from an artificial intelligence researcher who quit AI firm Anthropic went viral last week after it claimed AI could kill all humans by the end of the decade if left unchecked .

Other AI executives and experts responded saying they agreed . Then, over the weekend, Anthropic chief executive Dario Amodei called for the pace of all AI development to slow , external and urged governments to regulate the industry.

The post was applauded by OpenAI chief exuecutive Sam Altman, co-founder of Google's DeepMind Demis Hassabis, and Elon Musk, owner of social media site X and AI assistant Grok.

However, some industry figures have said the fears were overblown and were being jumped on to generate hype for the industry.

Addressing the potential dangers of AI at a salesforce conference in San Francisco on Tuesday, Huang referred to current advances as "a new industrial revolution" but insisted that AI companies should be left to essentially regulate themselves.

He added that if at any time a leader of an AI company lacks confidence in their product they should choose to not release it.

"That's a very obvious thing to do," Huang said. "Run as fast as you can, but if at any time you feel the institution is not in control, take a pause."

The idea of AI executives being left to entirely regulate themselves has struck some in the industry as a bad idea.

Jack Clark, an Anthropic executive and co-founder, told the BBC on Monday that leaving AI to be a "totally unregulated industry" was "rolling dice with immense risks" .

Patrick Hillman, the chief business officer of Logical Intelligence, which is chaired by Yann LeCun, a sage of the AI industry, noted Tuesday how little faith people have in tech companies to do anything truly in the public interest , external .

"The only institution that Americans might trust less than Washington these days is Silicon Valley. I have worked and lived in both and I assure you both have earned this scepticism," Hillman said.

"If you believe what you are building is dangerous, show us what you are prepared to stop doing," he added.

Leaders of OpenAI and...
body.zh: 英伟达老板黄仁勋表示，人工智能（AI）公司的负责人应该决定是否发布该技术的新版本，以回应人们对人工智能对人类威胁日益增长的担忧。 “我们不需要新的法律或法规，”黄说，并补充说，在人工智能产品的创新速度和安全性之间不应该有“错误的选择”。 按估值计算，英伟达是全球最大的公司，由于对其生产的人工智能计算芯片的需求旺盛，该公司的利润大幅增长。 黄仁勋对人工智能安全的立场与业内人士形成鲜明对比，后者最近表达了对该技术可能消灭人类的担忧。 一位退出人工智能公司 Anthropic 的人工智能研究人员的一篇帖子上周在网上疯传，该帖子声称，如果不加以控制，人工智能可能会在本世纪末杀死所有人类。 其他人工智能高管和专家回应称他们同意。然后，周末，Anthropic 首席执行官达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 呼吁所有人工智能外部发展步伐放缓，并敦促政府监管该行业。 这篇文章得到了 OpenAI 首席执行官 Sam Altman、谷歌 DeepMind Demis Hassabis 联合创始人以及社交媒体网站 X 和 AI 助手 Grok 所有者埃隆·马斯克 (Elon Musk) 的赞赏。 然而，一些行业人士表示，这种担忧被夸大了，并被用来炒作该行业。 周二在旧金山举行的销售人员会议上，黄仁勋在谈到人工智能的潜在危险时，将当前的进步称为“一场新的工业革命”，但坚持认为人工智能公司应该从本质上进行自我监管。 他补充说，如果人工智能公司的领导者在任何时候对他们的产品缺乏信心，他们应该选择不发布该产品。 “这是一件非常明显的事情，”黄说。 “尽可能快地跑，但如果任何时候你觉得机构失控了，就停下来。” 让人工智能高管完全自我监管的想法在一些业内人士看来是个坏主意。 Anthropic 高管兼联合创始人杰克·克拉克 (Jack Clark) 周一对 BBC 表示，让人工智能成为一个“完全不受监管的行业”就像“掷骰子，风险巨大”。 由人工智能行业圣人 Yann LeCun 领导的 Logical Intelligence 首席商务官帕特里克·希尔曼 (Patrick Hillman) 周二指出，人们对科技公司做任何真正符合公共利益、外部利益的事情缺乏信心。 “当今美国人唯一可能比华盛顿更不信任的机构是硅谷。我在这两个地方工作和生活过，我向你们保证，你们都受到了这种怀疑，”希尔曼说。 “如果你认为你正在建造的东西是危险的，请告诉我们你准备停止做什么，”他补充道。 OpenAI 的领导者和...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of AI, championed by leaders like Jensen Huang, brings immense praise and influence. Yet, as the technology's potential impact grows, so does the scrutiny. Proverbs 27:21 reminds us that a person is tested by the praise they receive. The challenge for innovators is to temper ambition with wisdom and responsibility, ensuring that the...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展，在黄仁勋等领导者的推动下，带来了巨大的赞誉和影响力。然而，随着这项技术潜在影响的扩大，审查也随之增加。箴言27:21提醒我们，人受到的试炼在于他所受的称赞。创新者面临的挑战是将雄心与智慧和责任相结合，确保追求进步不会超越伦理考量。

verse.textEn: The crucible for silver and the furnace for gold, but people are tested by their praise.
verse.textZh: 鼎为炼银，炉为炼金，人的称赞也试炼人。

title.en: Anthropic’s CEO calls for AI slowdown as Nvidia’s urges acceleration
title.zh: Anthropic CEO呼吁AI放缓，Nvidia CEO则主张加速

summary.en: At a San Francisco conference, Anthropic's CEO Dario Amodei reiterated his call for a slowdown in AI development, drawing an analogy to safety incidents in the automotive industry. This stance was contrasted by Nvidia's CEO, who argued against such deceleration.
summary.zh: 在旧金山的一次会议上，Anthropic的首席执行官Dario Amodei重申了他对人工智能发展放缓的呼吁，并将其比作汽车行业的安全事故。与此形成对比的是，英伟达的首席执行官则主张反对这种减速。

body.en: At San Francisco conference Dario Amodei reiterates need for AI slowdown as Jensen Huang argued against it Anthropic’s CEO took to the stage at a conference in San Francisco on Tuesday to reiterate his call for a slowdown of AI development. Following shortly after, Nvidia’s CEO argued against such deceleration. Dario Amodei used an automotive analogy to make his point: when a competing car company has a safety incident like brake failures, it is a moment for all car companies to stop and review their own practices, he said at Salesforce’s Dreamforce convention on Tuesday. “It’s very tempting to attack your competitor and say these guys are unsafe,” he said. “But I think the more responsible way to respond to it is to say, let’s look at our own record. We may not have had this big, high-profile incident, but I’m sure we’re not perfect.” Continue reading...
body.zh: 在旧金山会议上，达里奥·阿莫迪 (Dario Amodei) 重申人工智能放缓的必要性，但黄仁勋 (Jensen Huang) 对此表示反对。周二，Anthropic 的首席执行官在旧金山的一次会议上上台，重申他呼吁放缓人工智能的发展。不久之后，英伟达首席执行官反对这种减速。达里奥·阿莫代 (Dario Amodei) 在周二的 Salesforce Dreamforce 大会上表示，他用汽车类比来表达自己的观点：当竞争对手的汽车公司发生刹车失灵等安全事件时，所有汽车公司都应该停下来审视自己的做法。 “攻击你的竞争对手并说这些人不安全是非常诱人的，”他说。 “但我认为更负责任的回应方式是，让我们看看我们自己的记录。我们可能没有发生过这么大的、引人注目的事件，但我确信我们并不完美。”继续阅读...

reflection.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence presents humanity with a profound challenge, echoing the ancient story of Babel. When human ambition outpaces wisdom and caution, as seen in the differing views of AI leaders Dario Amodei and Jensen Huang, the potential for unintended consequences grows. We are called to pursue innovation with humility and a...
reflection.zh: 人工智能的飞速发展给人类带来了深刻的挑战，这与古代巴别塔的故事不谋而合。当人类的野心超越了智慧和谨慎时，正如Anthropic的Dario Amodei和英伟达的Jensen...

verse.textEn: Yahweh said, 'If as one people speaking the same language they have begun to do this, then nothing they plan to do will be impossible for them.'
verse.textZh: 雅伟说：「看哪，他们成为一样的人民，都是一样的言语，如今既做起这事来，以后他们所要做的事就没有不成就的了。」

title.en: Bernie Sanders and Steve Bannon call for curbs on AI at ‘pro-human’ summit
title.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯和史蒂夫·班农呼吁在“亲人类”峰会上限制人工智能

summary.en: Senator Bernie Sanders and strategist Steve Bannon, ideological opponents, united at the 'Pro-Human Assembly' to call for restrictions on artificial intelligence (AI). They warned of AI's potential dangers and demanded guardrails against Silicon Valley 'oligarchs,' though they presented differing views on a 'cold war'...
summary.zh: 左翼参议员伯尼·桑德斯和右翼战略家史蒂夫·班农在“亲人类集会”上呼吁限制人工智能（AI），尽管他们对与中国的“冷战”提出了不同的看法。两人都警告了AI的潜在危险，并要求对硅谷的“寡头”设置严格的限制措施。

body.en: Leftwing senator and far-right strategist rail against tech oligarchs but offer competing visions on Chinese ‘cold war’ The progressive senator Bernie Sanders and rightwing strategist Steve Bannon have called for restrictions on artificial intelligence (AI) but offered competing visions for what they termed a “cold war” with China. Speaking at the “Pro-Human Assembly” in Washington on Tuesday, the ideological adversaries were united in warning of the potential dangers of AI and demanding stringent guardrails against Silicon Valley’s “oligarchs”. Continue reading...
body.zh: 左翼参议员和极右翼战略家抨击科技寡头，但对中国“冷战”提出了相互竞争的愿景进步派参议员伯尼·桑德斯和右翼战略家史蒂夫·班农呼吁限制人工智能（AI），但对他们所谓的与中国的“冷战”提出了相互竞争的愿景。周二在华盛顿举行的“亲人类大会”上，意识形态对手联合起来警告人工智能的潜在危险，并要求对硅谷的“寡头”采取严格的防护措施。继续阅读...

reflection.en: In an era of rapid technological advancement, the 'Pro-Human Assembly' raises a crucial question: what does it mean to be human? The Bible grounds human dignity in our creation in the image of Yahweh (Genesis 1:27). This divine imprint calls us to ensure that technology serves humanity, rather than diminishes it, reflecting our inherent worth.
reflection.zh: 在一个技术飞速发展的时代，“亲人类集会”提出了一个关键问题：何以为人？《圣经》将人的尊严根植于我们是照着雅伟的形象被造（创世记 1:27）。这一神圣印记呼吁我们确保技术服务于人类，而非贬低人类，从而反映我们固有的价值。

verse.textEn: So God created mankind in his own image, in the image of God he created them; male and female he created them.
verse.textZh: 神就照着自己的形象造人，乃是照着他的形象造男造女。

title.en: Tech Life
title.zh: 科技生活

summary.en: The rapid advancement of artificial intelligence raises questions about what children should learn to navigate school and future careers. This report also touches on health tech using menstrual blood for disease data and satellite imaging for orangutan habitat protection.
summary.zh: 人工智能的快速发展引发了关于儿童应学习什么才能适应学校和未来职业生涯的问题。本报道还涉及利用月经血数据来发现疾病的健康科技，以及使用卫星图像保护红毛猩猩栖息地的相关内容。

body.en: AI is developing rapidly. What should parents and children make of it all? And how can young people navigate school and future careers when AI is becoming increasingly important? We speak to an expert who has written a new book about these issues. Also this week: we find out how one piece of health tech is helping scientists uncover disease-fighting data in menstrual blood. And satellite imaging is used by conservationists in Indonesia to protect the habitat of a rare species of orangutan. Presenter: Shiona McCallum Producer: Tom Quinn (Photo: A female school pupil sits at a laptop in a computer lab. She is wearing headphones. Credit: Getty Images)
body.zh: 人工智能正在快速发展。父母和孩子应该如何看待这一切？当人工智能变得越来越重要时，年轻人如何驾驭学校和未来的职业？我们采访了一位专家，他写了一本关于这些问题的新书。同样在本周：我们了解一项健康技术如何帮助科学家发现经血中的抗病数据。印度尼西亚的自然资源保护主义者利用卫星成像来保护稀有猩猩物种的栖息地。主持人：Shiona McCallum 制片人：Tom Quinn（照片：一名女学生坐在计算机实验室的笔记本电脑前。她戴着耳机。图片来源：Getty Images）

reflection.en: As artificial intelligence rapidly reshapes our world, the question of what knowledge is most vital for the next generation becomes paramount. Daniel's prophecy speaks of a time when 'knowledge shall increase,' a reality we now live within. May we seek wisdom not just in technological advancement, but in how to steward this growing understanding for the...
reflection.zh: 随着人工智能的飞速发展重塑我们的世界，关于下一代最关键的知识是什么的问题变得至关重要。但以理的预言谈到了一个“知识增长”的时代，这正是我们现在所处的现实。愿我们不仅在技术进步中寻求智慧，更在于如何运用日益增长的知识来造福所有人，特别是年轻人。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Bernie Sanders says Congress has been ‘asleep at the wheel’ over AI – video
title.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯称国会一直在“睡大觉”，对人工智能置若罔闻——视频

summary.en: Vermont senator Bernie Sanders criticized the advancement of artificial intelligence at the Pro-Human Assembly in Washington on Tuesday, warning that the current version of AI is 'the least capable version of AI that we will ever have.' He spoke alongside other AI skeptics, including Steve Bannon.
summary.zh: 佛蒙特州参议员伯尼·桑德斯周二在华盛顿举行的“亲人类大会”上批评了人工智能的进步，并警告说，当前版本的人工智能是“我们所能拥有的最不强大的人工智能”。他与其他人工智能怀疑论者一起发表了讲话，其中包括史蒂夫·班农。

body.en: Bernie Sanders criticised the advancement of artificial intelligence at the Pro-Human Assembly in Washington on Tuesday, warning that the current type of AI was 'the least capable version of AI that we will ever have'. The independent senator from Vermont was speaking at the conference alongside a number of AI sceptics, including Steve Bannon
body.zh: 伯尼·桑德斯周二在华盛顿亲人类大会上批评了人工智能的进步，警告说这个版本的人工智能是“我们所拥有的最没有能力的人工智能版本”。这位来自佛蒙特州的独立参议员在会议上与包括史蒂夫·班农 (Steve Bannon) 在内的一些人工智能怀疑论者一起发表讲话

reflection.en: Senator Sanders' urgent warning about artificial intelligence echoes a biblical theme of rapidly increasing knowledge. As technology races ahead, we are reminded of the need for wisdom and discernment, not just raw information. May we seek understanding that serves humanity and honors our Creator.
reflection.zh: 桑德斯参议员对人工智能发出的紧急警告，呼应了圣经中知识快速增长的主题。随着科技飞速发展，我们被提醒需要智慧和辨别力，而不仅仅是原始信息。愿我们寻求服务于人类并荣耀我们创造主的理解力。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: 18-year-old dies of measles in PA from severe neurological complication
title.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州一名18岁青少年因麻疹并发症死亡

summary.en: A fourth death from measles in Pennsylvania has been confirmed, involving an unvaccinated 18-year-old who developed acute disseminated encephalomyelitis (ADEM), a serious neurological complication of the disease. The state health department also reported another death in Jefferson County. Previously, two infant deaths...
summary.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州已确认第四例麻疹死亡病例，死者是一名未接种疫苗的18岁青少年，他患上了急性播散性脑脊髓炎（ADEM），这是麻疹一种严重的神经系统并发症。州卫生部还报告了杰斐逊县的另一例死亡病例。此前，兰开斯特县已报告了两例婴儿麻疹死亡病例。

body.en: A fourth person in Pennsylvania has died of measles, the state health department confirmed Tuesday . The latest death was in an unvaccinated 18-year-old resident of Mifflin County. In the announcement, the state health department also confirmed a county coroner's report over the weekend of the death of an unvaccinated 40-year-old woman in Jefferson County . The state had previously reported two deaths in Lancaster County, both were in infants— a newborn boy and a 6-week-old girl , both too young to be vaccinated. According to the Mifflin County coroner, Andrea L. Alcalde, the 18-year-old's cause of death was determined to be acute disseminated encephalomyelitis (ADEM) , which is a rare but known severe complication of measles. The condition is characterized by a rapidly progressing autoimmune disorder in which aberrant inflammation from an infection strips away the protective coverings of nerve cells in the brain and spinal cord. Before measles vaccines were widely used, ADEM was commonly associated with measles, though other viral infections can also spur its development. Read full article Comments
body.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州卫生部门周二证实，宾夕法尼亚州有第四人死于麻疹。最近的死亡病例是米夫林县一名未接种疫苗的 18 岁居民。在公告中，州卫生部门还证实了县验尸官周末的报告，称杰斐逊县一名未接种疫苗的 40 岁女性死亡。该州此前曾报告兰开斯特县有两例死亡病例，均为婴儿——一名新生男孩和一名六周大的女孩，两人都太小，无法接种疫苗。米夫林县验尸官 Andrea L. Alcalde 表示，这名 18 岁男孩的死因被确定为急性播散性脑脊髓炎 (ADEM)，这是一种罕见但已知的严重麻疹并发症。这种疾病的特点是快速进展的自身免疫性疾病，感染引起的异常炎症会剥夺大脑和脊髓神经细胞的保护层。在麻疹疫苗广泛使用之前，ADEM 通常与麻疹有关，尽管其他病毒感染也可以刺激其发展。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The tragic death of this young person from a measles complication is a stark reminder of the vulnerability of the human body. In times of illness and suffering, the call to pray for the sick, as James advises, offers both a pathway for compassion and a recognition of our dependence on divine care. May we extend comfort and support to those affected by such...
reflection.zh: 这位年轻人因麻疹并发症而悲惨离世，是对人类脆弱身体的严峻提醒。在疾病和苦难之时，雅各书所劝勉的为病人祷告，既是表达同情的方式，也是承认我们对神圣关怀的依赖。愿我们向那些受此类毁灭性疾病影响的人们伸出援手，给予安慰与支持。

verse.textEn: Is anyone among you sick? Let them call the elders of the church to pray over them.
verse.textZh: 你们中间有病了的呢，他就该请教会的长老来；他们可以奉主的名用油抹他，为他祷告。

title.en: SpaceX declares Starship ready for orbit, sets launch date next week
title.zh: SpaceX 宣布星舰已准备好进入轨道，下周设定发射日期

summary.en: SpaceX announced its intention to launch its 14th Starship mission as early as September 22, marking the first attempt to send the experimental vehicle into orbit. The rocket will carry Starlink satellites, with the upper stage aiming for six Earth orbits.
summary.zh: SpaceX 今日宣布，计划不早于 9 月 22 日进行其第 14 次星舰任务发射，这将是首次尝试将实验性飞行器送入轨道。该火箭将携带星链卫星，其上级将尝试绕地球轨道运行六圈。

body.en: Pending regulatory approval, SpaceX said today it intends to launch its 14th Starship mission as early as September 22. This flight is notable, as it will be the first time that SpaceX attempts to launch the experimental vehicle into orbit. The company set a target liftoff time of 7:15 am local in Texas (12:15 UTC), with a 75-minute launch window. Sunrise in Brownsville, Texas, is 7:17 am CT, so the launch could make for some striking imagery. The super heavy lift rocket will be carrying 26 of the larger V3 Starlink satellites into an orbit 275 km above the Earth. In an update on its website , SpaceX said the Starship upper stage will seek to complete six orbits around the Earth before completing its mission after about 10 hours. Read full article Comments
body.zh: SpaceX 今天表示，正在等待监管部门批准，它打算最早在 9 月 22 日发射第 14 次星舰任务。这次飞行值得注意，因为这将是 SpaceX 首次尝试将实验飞行器送入轨道。该公司将目标发射时间定为德克萨斯州当地时间上午 7:15（世界标准时间 12:15），发射窗口为 75 分钟。德克萨斯州布朗斯维尔的日出时间为中部时间上午 7 点 17 分，因此这次发射可能会产生一些引人注目的图像。超重型运载火箭将携带 26 颗较大的 V3 Starlink 卫星进入距地球 275 公里的轨道。 SpaceX 在其网站的更新中表示，星舰上级将寻求完成绕地球六圈的轨道，然后在大约 10 小时后完成其任务。阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: Humanity's drive to explore and achieve, exemplified by SpaceX's Starship endeavor, finds a spiritual echo in Proverbs 16:3. This verse encourages us to commit our plans and works to Yahweh, trusting that He will establish them. Even as engineers and scientists meticulously plan and execute, there is a deeper reliance on a power beyond their own to bring...
reflection.zh: 人类探索和成就的驱动力，以 SpaceX 的星舰计划为例，在箴言 16:3 中找到了精神上的共鸣。这节经文鼓励我们将计划和工作交托给雅伟，相信祂会成就。即使工程师和科学家一丝不苟地计划和执行，他们也更深层地依赖于超越自身的力量来实现他们宏伟的项目。

verse.textEn: Commit to Yahweh whatever you do, and he will establish your plans.
verse.textZh: 你所做的，要交托雅伟，你所谋的，就必成立。

title.en: Agility’s new humanoid robot will stop, squat to avoid harming human coworkers
title.zh: Agility新人形机器人将停止、下蹲以避免伤害人类同事

summary.en: Robots can begin working outside physical cages and without safety barriers.
summary.zh: 机器人可以开始在物理围栏外、没有安全屏障的情况下工作。

body.en: Agility Robotics has debuted its first humanoid robot engineered to work safely near humans without risking harm to flesh-and-blood coworkers. Such safety features could unlock many more opportunities to use such robots inside warehouses and automotive factories—all without requiring isolated robot work cells and physical separation barriers. When Agility’s new Digit 5 robot detects a person at a distance, it can autonomously take precautions, like moving to avoid the person or standing still so the person can pass by without getting closer. If a person is getting into close proximity with Digit 5, the robot can even choose to squat and assume a seated position. “The robot was designed with a complex safe motion system that can take a variety of different mitigations depending on exactly what sort of human presence is detected,” Pras Velagapudi , chief technology officer at Agility, told Ars. Read full article Comments
body.zh: Agility Robotics 推出了首款人形机器人，其设计可以在人类附近安全工作，而不会冒对有血有肉的同事造成伤害的风险。这些安全功能可以释放更多在仓库和汽车工厂内使用此类机器人的机会，而所有这些都不需要隔离的机器人工作单元和物理隔离屏障。当 Agility 的新型 Digit 5 机器人检测到远处有人时，它可以自主采取预防措施，例如移动以避开该人或静止不动，以便该人可以通过而不会靠近。如果一个人靠近数字 5，机器人甚至可以选择蹲下并采取坐姿。 Agility 首席技术官 Pras Velagapudi 告诉 Ars：“该机器人设计有一个复杂的安全运动系统，可以根据检测到的人类存在类型采取各种不同的缓解措施。”阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: The development of the Digit 5 robot, designed for safe collaboration with humans, speaks to the dignity and purpose inherent in engineered work. Colossians 3:23 reminds us to approach all tasks, whether human or robotic, with diligence and integrity, as if working directly for a higher purpose. This careful design reflects a commitment to responsible...
reflection.zh: Digit 5机器人的开发旨在与人类安全协作，这体现了工程工作的尊严和目的。歌罗西书3:23提醒我们，要以勤勉和正直的态度对待所有任务，无论是人类的还是机器人的，就如同直接为更高的目标而工作。 这种周密的设计体现了对负责任创新的承诺，技术的发展不仅是为了效率，也是为了考虑人类的福祉。

verse.textEn: Whatever you do, work at it with all your heart, as working for Yahweh, not for human masters.
verse.textZh: 无论做什么，都要从心里做，像是给主做的，不是给人做的。

title.en: Boston dumps Flock, says it shared data nationwide in violation of contract
title.zh: 波士顿因违约共享数据而放弃Flock，称其违反合同

summary.en: Boston has stopped using Flock Safety's license-plate reader cameras after the company allegedly shared data nationwide, violating a contract that required such sharing to be disabled. City officials cited a "vendor error" that led to this unauthorized data dissemination, as detailed in the city's annual surveillance...
summary.zh: 波士顿已停止使用Flock Safety的牌照识别摄像头，此前该公司据称违反合同规定，启用了全国范围的数据共享功能。市政府官员指出，这是一个“供应商错误”，导致了未经授权的数据传播，具体情况已在市政府的年度监控技术报告中披露。

body.en: The Boston city government abandoned Flock Safety's license-plate reader cameras after the company shared data nationwide in violation of a contract provision, according to city officials. "We have actually abandoned Flock," Boston Mayor Michelle Wu said in her monthly "Ask the Mayor" segment on GBH News last week. Wu made the comment a few days before the release of Boston's annual surveillance technology report , which said a Flock "vendor error" resulted in nationwide data sharing. The report, which covers 2025, describes how the Boston Police Department deployed about 45 Automated License Plate Reader (ALPR) cameras in a trial with Flock from April to September last year. The unauthorized data sharing occurred during the first few days of the pilot, the report said: Read full article Comments
body.zh: 据波士顿市官员称，在该公司违反合同条款在全国范围内共享数据后，波士顿市政府放弃了 Flock Safety 的车牌读取器摄像头。 “我们实际上已经放弃了 Flock，”波士顿市长 Michelle Wu 上周在 GBH News 的每月“询问市长”部分中说道。吴在波士顿年度监控技术报告发布前几天发表了上述评论，该报告称 Flock 的“供应商错误”导致了全国范围内的数据共享。该报告涵盖 2025 年，描述了去年 4 月至 9 月波士顿警察局如何在 Flock 试验中部署约 45 个自动车牌读取器 (ALPR) 摄像头。报告称，未经授权的数据共享发生在试点的最初几天： 阅读全文 评论

reflection.en: When technology companies are entrusted with sensitive data, their adherence to contractual agreements and ethical data handling is paramount. Boston's decision to abandon Flock Safety underscores the importance of accountability, reminding us that integrity in business practices is essential for maintaining public trust and upholding justice.
reflection.zh: 当科技公司被委托处理敏感数据时，它们遵守合同规定和进行合乎道德的数据处理至关重要。波士顿决定放弃Flock Safety，凸显了问责制的重要性，提醒我们商业实践中的诚信对于维持公众信任和伸张正义是必不可少的。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Pubs in England and Wales to allow digital ID apps to prove age
title.zh: 英威尔士酒吧允许使用数字身份证应用程序证明年龄

summary.en: New rules mean pubs and shops in England and Wales can accept digital ID apps alongside physical documents to verify age, aiming for quicker and more secure checks.
summary.zh: 新规意味着英格兰和威尔士的酒吧和商店可以接受数字身份证应用程序以及实体证件来验证年龄，旨在实现更快、更安全的检查。

body.en:
Alcohol buyers will be able to use a digital ID app on their phones to prove their age under new rules introduced on Tuesday.

Pubs and shops in England and Wales can use the tech in addition to current physical forms of ID - with the government saying a digital option will make age-checks quicker and more secure for customers and staff.

Customers will be able to choose ID apps from a range of suppliers such as the Post Office, Yoti or Luciditi, provided they are on a government-approved list.

The change means businesses will no longer be required to let people use physical ID, but the government contends most establishments would.

The plan will be technology-agnostic, meaning that the government is not setting out in detail how each app must work.

It argues that under the voluntary digital ID scheme, drinkers would share fewer personal details with a venue or shop - such as tapping their phone on a reader or displaying a scannable QR code rather than handing over an official document.

The apps will also need to guard against customers borrowing devices from older friends and relatives, and ensure the ID app belongs to the person using it.

Yoti's digital ID app, for example, will only let a user log in if a scan of their face matches that of the person who signed up for the app.

The app then generates a QR code that can be scanned by a business with a free checker app, which tells them the person's age.

Digital government minister Stephanie Peacock said having the option for digital ID would "mean you do not need to carry a physical ID, nor hand over sensitive personal information" meaning people could "feel safer on a night out'".

Allen Simpson, chief executive of trade body UKHospitality, said the new rules were a "positive step".

He added the industry would work with government to make sure the scheme's roll-out would not be "burdensome" for the hospitality sector.

This would include ensuring there were multiple options for suppliers and that it was cost-efficient, Simpson said.

The government wants digital ID apps under its scheme to work together so customers do not need to use different apps in different venues.

It also wants the services to work offline and accessible even without mobile data or a Wi-Fi connection.

In future, the digital proof of age scheme could be extended to cover tobacco and vapes.

But digital rights campaigners have said such measures could lead to the exclusion of some groups.

Jasleen Chaggar of Big Brother Watch said while having multiple ways to prove your identity was helpful, the Government should ensure that digital ID did not become effectively mandatory "as it would shut out millions of people".

"Many people have legitimate reasons for relying on physical ID, whether out of choice, privacy and...
body.zh: 根据周二推出的新规定，酒类购买者将能够使用手机上的数字身份应用程序来证明自己的年龄。 除了当前的实体身份证件之外，英格兰和威尔士的酒吧和商店还可以使用这项技术——政府表示，数字选项将使年龄检查对顾客和员工来说更快、更安全。 客户将能够从 Post Office、Yoti 或 Luciditi 等一系列供应商那里选择 ID 应用程序，前提是它们位于政府批准的列表中。 这一变化意味着企业将不再被要求让人们使用实体身份证，但政府认为大多数企业都会这样做。 该计划将与技术无关，这意味着政府不会详细说明每个应用程序必须如何运行。 它认为，根据自愿数字身份计划，饮酒者将与场所或商店分享更少的个人详细信息，例如将手机放在阅读器上或显示可扫描的二维码，而不是提交官方文件。 这些应用程序还需要防止客户从年长的朋友和亲戚那里借用设备，并确保 ID 应用程序属于使用它的人。 例如，Yoti 的数字身份证应用程序只有在面部​​扫描与注册该应用程序的人的面部扫描相匹配时才会允许用户登录。 然后，该应用程序会生成一个二维码，企业可以使用免费的检查应用程序扫描该二维码，从而得知该人的年龄。 数字政府部长斯蒂芬妮·皮科克表示，选择数字身份证“意味着你不需要携带实体身份证，也不需要交出敏感的个人信息”，这意味着人们可以“在晚上外出时感到更安全”。 贸易机构英国酒店业协会首席执行官艾伦·辛普森表示，新规定是“积极的一步”。 他补充说，该行业将与政府合作，确保该计划的推出不会给酒店业带来“负担”。 辛普森说，这包括确保供应商有多种选择，并且具有成本效益。 政府希望其计划下的数字身份应用程序能够协同工作，这样客户就不需要在不同的场所使用不同的应用程序。 它还希望这些服务能够离线工作，即使没有移动数据或 Wi-Fi 连接也可以访问。 未来，数字年龄证明计划可能会扩展到涵盖烟草和电子烟。 但数字权利活动人士表示，此类措施可能会导致某些群体被排除在外。 Big Brother Watch 的贾斯琳·查加尔 (Jasleen Chaggar) 表示，虽然有多种方法来证明你的身份很有帮助，但政府应该确保数字身份不会成为有效的强制措施，“因为这会将数百万人拒之门外”。 “许多人有合理的理由依赖实体身份证，无论是出于选择、隐私还是......

reflection.en: The digital age continues to accelerate, bringing new tools like age-verification apps. Daniel spoke of a time when knowledge would increase and many would hurry to and fro. This technological advancement is a clear sign of that prophecy being fulfilled, urging us to consider how we use this growing knowledge wisely and ethically.
reflection.zh: 数字时代持续加速，带来了诸如年龄验证应用程序之类的新工具。但以理曾预言，在末后的日子，知识将增多，人也必往返奔走。这项技术进步是这一预言实现的明显标志，促使我们思考如何明智且合乎道德地运用日益增长的知识。

verse.textEn: But you, Daniel, roll up and seal the words of the scroll until the time of the end. Many will go here and there to increase knowledge.
verse.textZh: 但以理啊，你要隐藏这话，封闭这书，直到末时。必有多人来往奔跑，知识就必增长。

title.en: Valve's Steam Frame is excellent - but at over £1,000 is VR still too expensive?
title.zh: Valve的Steam Frame表现出色——但超过1000英镑，VR是否仍然太贵了？

summary.en: Tom Gerken from the BBC gets hands-on with the latest virtual reality headset, the Steam Frame, and finds it to be excellent hardware but questions its high price point of over £1,000.
summary.zh: BBC的汤姆·格肯亲身体验了最新的虚拟现实头显Steam Frame，发现其硬件表现出色，但对其超过1000英镑的高昂价格提出了质疑。

body.en:
Valve's new virtual reality headset, the Steam Frame, has officially been released - but it comes at a high price.

The hardware is excellent - a light device which feels comfortable to wear and is packed with clever technology - so long as you're willing to pay a whopping £1,089 for a headset with 1TB of storage.

Both are capable of streaming from a PC as well as playing games on-device, with varying degrees of success.

But it carries a price tag which will make a lot of people roll their eyes, and doesn't do much to dispel criticism that increasingly-costly VR headsets are pricing people out of the hobby.

But before we get into that hefty price tag, is the Steam Frame actually any good?

I've owned VR headsets for well over a decade, and Valve's latest effort makes a promising first impression.

Games run well - really the bare minimum considering the price tag - and it's easy enough to use.

One of the nice things is, like Meta's Quest 3, it has flat "pancake" lenses allowing you to see clearly when you put the headset on.

It's light - weighing little more than a can of soup. But what makes it comfortable is the decision to separate the internals up.

The battery pack rests on the back of your head while the screen is at the front - meaning you don't feel front-heavy, a common criticism of other headsets.

But there are better screens out there. The PlayStation VR2 for example has incredible OLED displays, albeit without the pancake lenses.

Yet these come at a serious premium, costing significantly more than the Steam Frame.

When Meta launched the Quest 3 in June 2023, its 128GB model retailed for £480. Less storage, but a much lower price.

Three years later, it's hard to believe VR just keeps getting more expensive when the Quest 3 felt like a turning point.

"VR today is ultimately a high-end niche," gaming writer Christopher Dring told me.

"Meta had been subsidising the Quest hardware, and it's difficult to imagine they will going forward as they pivot away from those experiences."

Of course, there are reasons for prices going up. AI developers are building giant data centres filled with racks of powerful servers, using many of the same components needed to make devices like the Steam Frame.

Ram prices alone more than doubled in price between October 2025 and the start of 2026 . Meanwhile, the graphics card I bought for £500 a few months ago now sits at closer to £650.

As prices climb higher and higher, hardware developers don't have much of a choice but to put up their own.

"We set out to come out with a device that would have been much more affordable," Valve developer Jeremy Selan said.

"But the global Ram market has impacted us the same way it's impacted everybody."

"The idea that it's too expensive is one of the biggest...
body.zh: Valve 的新款虚拟现实耳机 Steam Frame 已正式发布，但价格高昂。 其硬件非常出色，是一款佩戴舒适、采用巧妙技术的轻便设备，只要您愿意花 1,089 英镑购买一款具有 1TB 存储空间的耳机。 两者都能够从 PC 上进行流媒体播放，也能够在设备上玩游戏，并取得了不同程度的成功。 但它的价格标签会让很多人翻白眼，而且并不能消除人们对日益昂贵的虚拟现实头显让人们放弃这项爱好的批评。 但在我们讨论这个高昂的价格之前，Steam Frame 真的好吗？ 我拥有 VR 耳机已有十多年了，Valve 的最新成果给我留下了美好的第一印象。 游戏运行良好——考虑到价格标签，这确实是最低限度——而且它很容易使用。 优点之一是，与 Meta 的 Quest 3 一样，它具有扁平的“煎饼”镜片，让您戴上耳机时可以清晰地看到。 它很轻——只比一罐汤重一点。但让它感到舒适的是决定将内部结构分开。 电池组位于您的后脑勺上，而屏幕位于前面，这意味着您不会感到前部沉重，这是其他耳机常见的批评。 但还有更好的屏幕。例如，PlayStation VR2 拥有令人难以置信的 OLED 显示屏，尽管没有薄饼镜头。 然而，这些产品的溢价非常高，其成本远远高于 Steam Frame。 当 Meta 于 2023 年 6 月推出 Quest 3 时，其 128GB 型号的零售价为 480 英镑。存储空间更少，但价格却低得多。 三年后，当 Quest 3 感觉像是一个转折点时，很难相信 VR 会变得越来越贵。 “今天的虚拟现实最终是一个高端利基市场，”游戏作家克里斯托弗·德林告诉我。 “Meta 一直在补贴 Quest 硬件，很难想象他们会在放弃这些体验时继续前进。” 当然，价格上涨是有原因的。人工智能开发人员正在建造巨大的数据中心，其中充满了强大服务器的机架，使用许多与制造 Steam Frame 等设备所需的相同组件。 从 2025 年 10 月到 2026 年初，仅公羊的价格就上涨了一倍多。与此同时，我几个月前花 500 英镑购买的显卡现在价格接近 650 英镑。 随着价格越来越高，硬件开发商别无选择，只能自己开发。 Valve 开发者杰里米·塞兰 (Jeremy Selan) 表示：“我们打算推出一款价格更加实惠的设备。” “但全球公羊市场对我们的影响就像对每个人的影响一样。” “价格太贵是最大的想法之一......

reflection.en: The Steam Frame headset is lauded for its excellent technology and comfortable design, but its steep price of £1,089 raises questions about accessibility. This echoes the biblical caution that while knowledge and capability may advance, not everything that can be done is necessarily beneficial or wise for all people.
reflection.zh: Steam Frame头显因其出色的技术和舒适的设计而受到赞扬，但其高达1089英镑的昂贵价格引发了关于可及性的问题。这呼应了圣经中的告诫：虽然知识和能力可能在进步，但并非所有能做到的事情都对所有人有益或明智。

verse.textEn: "I have the right to do anything," you say — but not everything is beneficial. "I have the right to do anything" — but not everything is constructive.
verse.textZh: 凡事都可行，但不都有益处；凡事都可行，但不都造就人。

title.en: Creation Desk
title.zh: 受造世界

strap.en: The world Yahweh made — its wonders, and the toll of a warming, wounded earth.
strap.zh: 雅伟所造的世界——它的奇妙，以及一个渐暖、渐伤的地球所付的代价。

title.en: Marine heatwave likely caused sharp decline in Hawaiian humpback whales, study finds
title.zh: 研究发现：海洋热浪可能导致夏威夷座头鲸数量急剧下降

summary.en: A recent study suggests that a marine heatwave in the northeastern Pacific Ocean, which occurred roughly a decade ago and caused a significant decline in forage fish and krill populations, also led to a sharp decrease in the Hawaiian humpback whale population. The study analyzed over 27,000 whale photos to assess the...
summary.zh: 一项最新研究表明，大约十年前发生在东北太平洋的海洋热浪，导致了作为海洋食物链基础的饵料鱼类和磷虾数量的急剧下降。该研究分析了超过27,000张鲸鱼照片，以评估2013-2016年热浪的影响，结果发现夏威夷座头鲸的数量也在此期间急剧减少，并且至今尚未恢复。

body.en: Roughly a decade ago, a marine heatwave in the northeastern Pacific Ocean caused a dramatic decline in populations of forage fish and krill, the base of the marine food chain. A recent study found that the Hawaiian humpback whale population, which feeds on krill and small fish, also declined sharply during the 2013-16 heatwave and has not yet recovered. Humpback whales (Megaptera novaeangliae) in the North Pacific feed in cold Alaskan and Canadian waters during the summer months before traveling roughly 4,800 kilometers (3,000 miles) to Hawaii to breed and give birth over the winter. To understand the impact of the 2013-2016 marine heatwave, researchers analyzed more than 27,000 photos of whale sightings between 2002 and 2023 across the main Hawaiian islands. The photos came from Happywhale, a citizen science platform where anyone can upload images of whale flukes (tail fins) that scientists use to identify individuals. “Their flukes are a bit like a fingerprint for each individual humpback whale,” study co-author Shannon Barber-Meyer, formerly with Pacific Whale Foundation, told Mongabay in a video call. The researchers found the Hawaiian humpback whale population declined by 37% between the 2014-2015 breeding season and the 2021-2022 season. Adult survival rates also fell sharply. Before the heatwave, roughly 99% of adult whales survived year over year, but during the heatwave, adult survival was estimated at just 68%. “It’s a very precipitous drop, and that’s not something you normally see in adult survival of long-lived mammals,” Barber-Meyer said. During the heatwave, researchers documented an unusual mortality event…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 大约十年前，东北太平洋的海洋热浪导致海洋食物链基础的饲料鱼和磷虾数量急剧下降。最近的一项研究发现，以磷虾和小鱼为食的夏威夷座头鲸数量在2013-16年热浪期间也急剧下降，至今尚未恢复。北太平洋的座头鲸 (Megaptera novaeangliae) 夏季在寒冷的阿拉斯加和加拿大水域捕食，然后航行约 4,800 公里（3,000 英里）前往夏威夷在冬季繁殖和分娩。为了了解 2013 年至 2016 年海洋热浪的影响，研究人员分析了 2002 年至 2023 年期间夏威夷主要岛屿上 27,000 多张鲸鱼目击照片。这些照片来自 Happywhale，这是一个公民科学平台，任何人都可以上传鲸鱼尾鳍的图像，科学家用这些图像来识别个体。 “它们的尾鳍有点像每头座头鲸的指纹，”该研究的合著者、前太平洋鲸鱼基金会的香农·巴伯-迈耶在视频通话中告诉 Mongabay。研究人员发现，从 2014-2015 年繁殖季到 2021-2022 年繁殖季，夏威夷座头鲸数量减少了 37%。成人存活率也急剧下降。在热浪发生之前，大约 99% 的成年鲸鱼逐年存活下来，但在热浪期间，成年鲸鱼的存活率估计仅为 68%。 “这是一个非常急剧的下降，这在长寿哺乳动物的成年存活率中通常不会看到，”巴伯-迈耶说。在热浪期间，研究人员记录了一次不寻常的死亡事件……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The intricate web of life, from the smallest krill to the majestic humpback whale, is deeply interconnected. This study reveals how environmental shifts, like marine heatwaves, can disrupt this delicate balance, causing cascading effects that threaten entire populations. It echoes the biblical sense of creation itself groaning under the strain of ecological...
reflection.zh: 从微小的磷虾到雄伟的座头鲸，生命的复杂网络紧密相连。这项研究揭示了海洋热浪等环境变化如何扰乱这种微妙的平衡，造成连锁反应，威胁到整个种群。这呼应了圣经中关于受造界因生态困境而叹息的观念，提醒我们有责任关爱地球。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Air pollution linked to higher suicide risk, international research suggests
title.zh: 空气污染与自杀风险升高有关，国际研究表明

summary.en: An analysis of 29 studies suggests that exposure to fine particulate matter and nitrogen dioxide in the air is associated with a higher risk of suicide and suicidal thoughts. While pollution's link to poorer mental health is known, its specific role in suicide risk is less understood.
summary.zh: 对29项研究的分析表明，空气中的细颗粒物和二氧化氮暴露与自杀及自杀念头风险升高有关。虽然污染与心理健康状况不佳的联系是已知的，但其在自杀风险中的具体作用尚不明确。

body.en: Analysis of 29 studies highlights potentially heightened danger from small particulate matter and nitrogen dioxide Air pollution is associated with an increased risk of suicide and suicidal thoughts, according to research. Environmental pollution is known to be associated with poorer mental health but its role in suicide risk is less well understood. Scientists at Queen’s University Belfast examined whether air, noise, light, and water pollution could influence the risk of death by suicide and suicidal behaviours. Continue reading...
body.zh: 对 29 项研究的分析强调，小颗粒物和二氧化氮可能会增加潜在的危险 研究表明，空气污染与自杀和自杀念头风险增加有关。众所周知，环境污染与心理健康状况不佳有关，但其在自杀风险中的作用尚不清楚。贝尔法斯特女王大学的科学家研究了空气、噪音、光和水污染是否会影响自杀和自杀行为的死亡风险。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The news that air pollution may increase suicide risk is a stark reminder of how deeply our environment affects our inner lives. It echoes the profound despair of Elijah, who, after facing immense pressure, wished for death, saying, 'I have had enough.' This connection calls us to care for the earth not only for its own sake but for the sake of human...
reflection.zh: 空气污染可能增加自杀风险的消息，令人警醒地认识到我们的环境如何深刻影响我们的内心世界。这呼应了以利亚的深切绝望，他在承受巨大压力后，曾说‘我受够了’，并求死。这一联系提醒我们，不仅要爱惜大地，也要关怀人类的繁荣和心理健康。

verse.textEn: He came to a broom bush, sat down under it and prayed that he might die. 'I have had enough, Yahweh,' he said. 'Take my life; I am no better than my ancestors.'
verse.textZh: 他自己在旷野走了一日的路程，来到一棵罗腾树下，就坐在那里求死，说：「雅伟啊，罢了！求你取我的性命，因为我不胜于我的列祖。」

title.en: 3M, DuPont and more to face lawsuit on Pfas in US firefighters’ protective gear
title.zh: 3M、杜邦等公司因消防员防护装备中的PFAS面临诉讼

summary.en: Connecticut plaintiffs are suing over 20 defendants, including 3M, DuPont, and Honeywell, alleging that 'forever chemicals' in firefighters' protective gear increase cancer risk through absorption and inhalation. A federal judge has allowed these claims to proceed.
summary.zh: 康涅狄格州的原告正在起诉包括3M、杜邦和霍尼韦尔在内的20多名被告，声称消防员防护装备中的“永久化学物质”通过吸收和吸入增加了患癌症的风险。一名联邦法官已允许这些诉讼继续进行。

body.en: Connecticut plaintiffs say ‘forever chemicals’ in turnout gear increase risk of cancer by absorption and inhalation A federal judge on Tuesday said more than 20 defendants including 3M , DuPont and Honeywell must ⁠face claims by Connecticut firefighters who said their protective gear was contaminated by toxic “forever chemicals” that increased their risk of cancer. Lawyers ⁠for 13 firefighter union ⁠organizations and ​12 individual firefighters said “turnout gear” that shields against extreme heat and flames leached the chemicals through absorption into skin, ingestion and inhalation. ⁠They have called the proposed class action the first to exclusively target firefighter gear containing per- and polyfluoroalkyl substances, or Pfas . Continue reading...
body.zh: 康涅狄格州原告称，消防服中的“永久化学物质”会通过吸收和吸入增加患癌症的风险。周二，一名联邦法官表示，包括 3M、杜邦和霍尼韦尔在内的 20 多名被告必须面对康涅狄格州消防员的索赔，他们称他们的防护装备受到有毒“永久化学物质”的污染，增加了患癌症的风险。 13 个消防员工会组织和 12 名个体消防员的律师表示，抵御极热和火焰的“消防装备”会通过皮肤吸收、摄入和吸入来滤出化学物质。他们称拟议的集体诉讼是第一个专门针对含有全氟烷基物质和多氟烷基物质（Pfa）的消防员装备的集体诉讼。继续阅读...

reflection.en: Firefighters, who bravely shield us from flames, are now facing health risks from the very gear meant to protect them. This lawsuit brings to light the complex interplay between industrial production and human well-being, raising questions of corporate responsibility. May we seek justice and accountability, remembering the call to act justly, love mercy,...
reflection.zh: 消防员冒着生命危险保护我们免受烈焰的侵害，如今却面临着他们赖以保护的装备所带来的健康风险。这场诉讼揭示了工业生产与人类福祉之间复杂的相互作用，并引发了对企业责任的质疑。愿我们寻求公义和问责，并铭记那要行公义、好怜悯、存谦卑的心与神同行的呼召。

verse.textEn: What does Yahweh require of you? To act justly and to love mercy and to walk humbly with your God.
verse.textZh: 雅伟向你所要的是什么呢？只要你行公义，好怜悯，存谦卑的心，与你的神同行。

title.en: Right-wing leaders could rule 95% of the Amazon by 2027, experts warn
title.zh: 专家警告：到2027年，右翼领导人可能统治亚马逊雨林95%的地区

summary.en: Experts warn that by 2027, right-wing or far-right parties could be leading five of the nine Amazonian countries, potentially increasing risks to the rainforest. Brazil, which holds over 60% of the Amazon, is facing a close election between a left-wing incumbent and the son of a former far-right president.
summary.zh: 专家警告，到2027年，亚马逊地区的九个国家中可能有五个由右翼或极右翼政党执政，这将对雨林构成新的风险。巴西拥有亚马逊地区60%以上的土地，其即将举行的选举将在左翼现任总统和一位前极右翼总统的儿子之间展开激烈竞争。

body.en: In January 2027, five of the nine Amazonian countries could be run by right-wing or far-right parties, posing new risks to the world’s greatest rainforest, experts warn. Peru, Colombia, Bolivia, and Ecuador have already elected presidents who explicitly favor agribusiness and mining over environmental conservation. Brazil, home to more than 60% of the Amazon, could be next. According to polls, the left-wing incumbent, Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva, is neck and neck ahead of October’s ballot against Flávio Bolsonaro, the eldest son of Jair Bolsonaro, the far-right president he defeated in the last election four years ago. The elder Bolsonaro has since been convicted for an attempted coup d’état, imprisoned, and barred from running for office. Venezuela, run by a nominally socialist regime but now under economic intervention from the U.S., is facing mounting pressure from President Donald Trump to boost oil production and sign new mining deals, raising environmental concerns in the country. Together, these six nations cover up to 95% of the Amazon. Experts say Brazil’s election will have high stakes for the Amazon and other biomes, especially as the younger Bolsonaro looks set to revive his father’s policies. Opposition presidential candidate Flávio Bolsonaro, left, greets El Salvador’s Minister of Justice and Public Security, Hector Gustavo Villatoro, during a meeting, in São Paulo, Sunday, Aug. 30, 2026. Image by AP Photo/Andre Penner. “Even under a government that is somewhat committed to combating deforestation, the task is already very difficult,” Márcio Astrini, executive secretary of the Climate Observatory, a…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 专家警告说，到 2027 年 1 月，亚马逊河流域九个国家中的五个可能由右翼或极右翼政党统治，这对世界上最大的热带雨林构成新的风险。秘鲁、哥伦比亚、玻利维亚和厄瓜多尔已经选出了明确支持农业综合企业和采矿业而非环境保护的总统。拥有亚马逊 60% 以上面积的巴西可能是下一个。民意调查显示，左翼现任总统路易斯·伊纳西奥·卢拉·达席尔瓦在十月的投票中与弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗旗鼓相当。弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗是雅伊尔·博尔索纳罗的长子，博尔索纳罗是极右翼总统，四年前，他在上次选举中击败了博尔索纳罗。老博尔索纳罗此后因未遂政变被定罪、入狱，并被禁止竞选公职。委内瑞拉名义上由社会主义政权统治，但现在受到美国的经济干预，它面临着唐纳德·特朗普总统越来越大的压力，要求其增加石油产量并签署新的采矿协议，这引发了该国的环境问题。这六个国家总共覆盖了亚马逊地区 95% 的面积。专家表示，巴西的选举对于亚马逊和其他生物群落来说意义重大，尤其是年轻的博尔索纳罗似乎将恢复其父亲的政策。 2026 年 8 月 30 日星期日，反对派总统候选人弗拉维奥·博尔索纳罗（左）在圣保罗举行的一次会议上向萨尔瓦多司法和公共安全部长赫克托·古斯塔沃·维拉托罗致意。图片由美联社照片/Andre Penner 提供。气候观测站执行秘书马西奥·阿斯特里尼 (Márcio Astrini) 表示：“即使政府在一定程度上致力于打击森林砍伐，这项任务也已经非常艰巨。”

reflection.en: The potential shift in leadership across several Amazonian nations raises concerns for the future of the rainforest. Proverbs 29:2 reminds us that 'When the righteous are in authority, the people rejoice, but when the wicked rule, the people groan.' The story's focus on leaders prioritizing economic exploitation over environmental stewardship echoes this...
reflection.zh: 多个亚马逊国家领导层的潜在转变引发了对雨林未来的担忧。《箴言》29章2节提醒我们：“义人掌权，百姓喜乐；恶人掌权，百姓叹息。”故事中领导人优先考虑经济开发而非环境保护，这呼应了关于治理对土地及其人民影响的古老智慧。

verse.textEn: When the righteous thrive, the people rejoice; when the wicked rule, the people groan.
verse.textZh: 义人增多，民就喜乐；恶人掌权，民就叹息。

title.en: ‘Big Cats’ highlights the remarkable power of photojournalism
title.zh: “大猫”凸显摄影新闻的非凡力量

summary.en: Jeff Sikich, a biologist with the National Park Service in Griffith Park, Los Angeles, initially doubted Steve Winter's ability to photograph a mountain lion near the Hollywood sign. Winter, however, persisted for about a year and succeeded in capturing an image of the famous mountain lion, P-22, with the Hollywood...
summary.zh: 洛杉矶格里菲斯公园国家公园管理局的生物学家杰夫·西基奇（Jeff Sikich）最初怀疑史蒂夫·温特（Steve...

body.en: Jeff Sikich, the biologist for the National Park Service in Griffith Park, Los Angeles, thought that Steve Winter “was crazy” for wanting to capture a photograph of a mountain lion in front of the Hollywood sign. “He looked at me like I was crazy because he said, ‘There are no mountain lions in Griffith Park.’ But I knew in the past that there had been,” Winter says. It took him around a year, but Winter managed to do it. He captured the famous mountain lion, named P-22 by scientists, sauntering down a hill at night wearing his tracking collar, with the Hollywood sign shimmering in the background. This helped spark a conservation movement in L.A. and eventually inspired funding for the Wallis Annenberg Wildlife Crossing over U.S. Route 101, which will be the world’s largest wildlife crossing when it opens on Dec. 2. Winter and Mongabay contributing editor Sharon Guynup join the Mongabay Newscast this week to detail this story and others that are featured in her and Winter’s upcoming book of impactful photojournalism, Big Cats from Nat Geo Books. Each of the nine stories in this book was selected specifically for the conservation outcomes these stories helped inspire. “We really wanted to emphasize that storytelling and photography can change the world. And beyond that, we all can have impact, so we all need to contribute our skills, whatever they are,” Guynup says. After reading all 25,000 words, this book stands out to me as more than a collection of…This article was originally published on Mongabay
body.zh: 洛杉矶格里菲斯公园国家公园管理局的生物学家杰夫·西基奇 (Jeff Sikich) 认为，史蒂夫·温特想要在好莱坞标志前拍摄美洲狮的照片，这“太疯狂了”。 “他看着我，就像我疯了一样，因为他说，‘格里菲斯公园里没有山狮。’但我过去就知道曾经有过，”温特说。他花了大约一年的时间，但温特成功做到了。他捕捉到了这只被科学家命名为 P-22 的著名山狮，它在夜间戴着追踪项圈从山上漫步下来，背景中好莱坞标志闪闪发光。这引发了洛杉矶的保护运动，并最终为美国 101 号公路上的 Wallis Annenberg 野生动物过境点筹集了资金，该过境点将于 12 月 2 日开放，届时将成为世界上最大的野生动物过境点。Winter 和 Mongabay 特约编辑 Sharon Guynup 本周加入 Mongabay Newscast，详细介绍了这个故事以及她和 Winter 即将出版的颇具影响力的新闻摄影作品《来自国家地理图书》的《大猫》中的其他故事。本书中的九个故事中的每一个都是专门为这些故事所激发的保护成果而选择的。 “我们真的想强调讲故事和摄影可以改变世界。除此之外，我们都可以产生影响，所以我们都需要贡献我们的技能，无论它们是什么，”盖纳普说。读完全部 25,000 字后，这本书对我来说不仅仅是一本集合……本文最初发表于 Mongabay

reflection.en: The image of P-22, the mountain lion, against the iconic Hollywood sign is a testament to the intricate beauty and resilience of wildlife, even in urban landscapes. It reminds us that Yahweh's creation is filled with wonder and wisdom, inviting us to observe and learn from the natural world around us. This photographic achievement not only captured a rare...
reflection.zh: P-22美洲狮与标志性的好莱坞标志同框的画面，证明了野生动物在城市景观中依然拥有令人惊叹的美丽和韧性。它提醒我们，雅伟的创造充满了奇妙与智慧，邀请我们去观察和学习身边的自然世界。 这一摄影成就不仅捕捉了一个罕见的瞬间，还推动了保护工作，表明艺术能够启迪人们对与我们共享这个星球的生灵的关怀。

verse.textEn: How many are your works, Yahweh! In wisdom you made them all; the earth is full of your creatures.
verse.textZh: 雅伟啊，你所造的何其多！都是你用智慧造成的；遍地满了你的丰富。

title.en: Indonesian wildfires threaten leading orangutan research site in Borneo
title.zh: 印度尼西亚野火威胁婆罗洲猩猩主要研究地

summary.en: Critically endangered Bornean orangutans are fleeing their forest homes as staff at the Cabang Panti research site work tirelessly to combat a wildfire. The blaze has reached within 200 meters of the Rangkong research station, a satellite of the main Cabang Panti station in Gunung Palung national park, threatening one...
summary.zh: 极度濒危的婆罗洲猩猩正逃离森林家园，而卡邦潘提研究站的工作人员正不懈努力地扑灭野火。大火已逼近 Gunung Palung 国家公园内卡邦潘提研究站卫星站Rangkong研究站200米以内，威胁着全球最长期的野生猿类研究之一。

body.en: Critically endangered Bornean orangutans flee forests as staff at Cabang Panti work round the clock to stave off blaze Wildfires in Indonesia are sweeping through a critical research site for Bornean orangutans and are now threatening a celebrated research camp, home to one of the world’s longest-running studies of wild apes. In the past few days, the fires have burned within 200 metres of Rangkong research station, a satellite of Cabang Panti research station, which lies about four miles north in Gunung Palung national park. Continue reading...
body.zh: 极度濒临灭绝的婆罗洲猩猩逃离森林，卡邦潘蒂的工作人员昼夜不停地工作以扑灭大火。印度尼西亚的野火正在席卷婆罗洲猩猩的一个重要研究地点，现在正威胁着一个著名的研究营地，这里是世界上进行时间最长的野生猿研究的所在地。过去几天，大火已蔓延至Rangkong研究站200米范围内，Rangkong研究站是Cabang Panti研究站的卫星，位于Gunung Palung国家公园以北约4英里。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The fires raging through Borneo's forests are a stark reminder of creation's vulnerability. The orangutans' flight and the researchers' desperate efforts to save their site echo the Apostle Paul's description of all creation groaning in travail, awaiting redemption. May we recognize our role in stewarding this fragile world and act with greater care.
reflection.zh: 在婆罗洲森林中肆虐的大火，是对受造界脆弱性的严峻提醒。猩猩的逃离和研究人员拯救其研究点的绝望努力，呼应了使徒保罗所描述的，万物一同劳苦叹息，等候得赎的情形。愿我们认识到自己在这脆弱世界上的管家之责，并以更大的关怀去行动。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: From Indigenous Loss, a Potent Legal Argument on Climate
title.zh: 从原住民的损失中，一个强有力的气候法律论点

summary.en: Human rights lawyer Julian Aguon discusses how global warming endangers not only the existence of small island nations but also the cultural traditions of their Indigenous inhabitants. He is incorporating these harms into legal challenges, which have already seen a significant victory at the International Court of...
summary.zh: 人权律师朱利安·阿圭恩探讨了全球变暖如何不仅威胁到小岛屿国家的生存，也威胁到其原住民的传统。他正在将这些伤害纳入法律诉讼，包括在国际法院取得重大胜利。

body.en:
Human rights lawyer Julian Aguon explores how warming threatens not only the survival of small island nations but also the traditions of their Indigenous peoples. He is citing these injuries in legal actions, including in a major victory at the International Court of Justice last year.

Last year, the International Court of Justice unanimously ruled that countries have a legal obligation to limit greenhouse gas emissions. The decision was the culmination of a years-long campaign launched by a group of law students in the Pacific island nation of Vanuatu.

The landmark opinion , which said countries’ failure to address emissions from fossil fuels and other sources could carry legal consequences, provides a potentially powerful new tool for communities, organizations, or governments suing in national courts to compel climate action or win damages. It could also push international climate negotiators toward a more aggressive stance on a danger the judges called “urgent and existential.”

Julian Aguon, an Indigenous Chamorro human rights lawyer from Guam, wore a garland of coconut fronds and cowry shells as he argued Vanuatu’s case in The Hague. He and his colleagues had traveled across Melanesia and Micronesia to gather testimony from residents whose homes, cultures, and livelihoods are being devastated by climate change.

While the impact of climate change is typically measured in degrees of warming, feet of flooding, or monetary losses, for many Indigenous people it is inflicting a profound cultural, spiritual, and emotional injury that the sterile language of science and economics fails to capture, said Aguon, founder of the Guam-based Indigenous rights and environmental justice firm Blue Ocean Law. In an interview with Yale Environment 360, he said that highlighting the harms Indigenous peoples and cultures are suffering proved a potent legal strategy at the United Nations’ main judicial body.

“Climate change is unraveling the very terms by which people know themselves and keep covenant with the natural world.” In the ICJ case, he said, “we brought that to the court’s attention because these are rights violations of the highest order — violations of the right to life, the right to culture, the right to self-determination.”

Yale Environment 360 : Can you tell me about the testimonies you and your colleagues gathered when you traveled to Vanuatu, Fiji, and other island nations in preparation for the case? How did they shape your arguments in court?

Julian Aguon : There’s no way to translate the urgency and gravity of the climate crisis other than via firsthand accounts of loss and damage, so we wanted to foreground vulnerable communities’ experiences. The process revealed in spectacular ways just how emaciated the global discourse on climate harms...
body.zh: 人权律师朱利安·阿古恩探讨了气候变暖如何不仅威胁小岛屿国家的生存，而且威胁其土著人民的传统。他在法律诉讼中引用了这些伤害，包括去年在国际法院取得的重大胜利。 去年，国际法院一致裁定各国有限制温室气体排放的法律义务。这一决定是太平洋岛国瓦努阿图的一群法律学生发起的长达数年运动的高潮。 这一具有里程碑意义的意见指出，各国未能解决化石燃料和其他来源的排放问题可能会带来法律后果，为社区、组织或政府在国家法院提起诉讼以强制采取气候行动或赢得损害赔偿提供了一个潜在的强大新工具。它还可能促使国际气候谈判代表对法官所说的“紧迫且事关生死存亡”的危险采取更积极的立场。 来自关岛的查莫罗原住民人权律师朱利安·阿古恩 (Julian Aguon) 在海牙为瓦努阿图的案件辩护时戴着椰子叶和贝壳制成的花环。他和他的同事们走遍了美拉尼西亚和密克罗尼西亚，收集那些家园、文化和生计正受到气候变化破坏的居民的证词。 总部位于关岛的原住民权利和环境正义公司“蓝海法”的创始人阿古恩表示，虽然气候变化的影响通常以变暖程度、洪水深度或金钱损失来衡量，但对许多原住民来说，它正在造成深刻的文化、精神和情感伤害，这是科学和经济学语言无法捕捉到的。在接受耶鲁环境 360 采访时，他表示，事实证明，强调土著人民和文化所遭受的伤害是联合国主要司法机构的有效法律策略。 “气候变化正在瓦解人们认识自己并与自然世界保持契约的条件。”他说，在国际法院案件中，“我们提请法院注意这一点，因为这些都是最高级别的侵犯权利行为——侵犯生命权、文化权和自决权。” 耶鲁环境 360：您能告诉我您和您的同事在前往瓦努阿图、斐济和其他岛国准备此案时收集的证词吗？他们如何影响你在法庭上的论点？ 朱利安·阿古恩：除了通过损失和损害的第一手资料之外，没有其他方法可以体现气候危机的紧迫性和严重性，因此我们希望突出弱势社区的经历。这一过程以惊人的方式揭示了全球关于气候危害的讨论是多么的无力……

reflection.en: In the face of climate change, the voices of Indigenous peoples and small island nations are often drowned out. Julian Aguon's legal advocacy, however, amplifies their suffering and demands accountability, embodying the principle of speaking for those who cannot speak for themselves. His work reminds us that justice requires us to champion the cause of the...
reflection.zh: 面对气候变化，原住民和小岛屿国家的呼声常常被淹没。然而，朱利安·阿圭恩的法律倡导放大了他们的痛苦，并要求问责，体现了为那些不能为自己发声的人说话的原则。他的工作提醒我们，正义要求我们为弱势群体争取权益，确保他们的困境被听到和解决。

verse.textEn: Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for the rights of all who are destitute. Speak up and judge fairly; defend the rights of the poor and needy.
verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

summary.zh: 德比郡普里斯特克利夫草地：这景象——还有这声音——真是太壮观了，一大群雏鸟在风吹动植被时觅食。一米多高的簇绒发草在夏日的热浪中烧成米黄色，被强劲的秋季西风搅动着。大约200只金翅雀，其中大部分是今年的幼鸟，在摇曳的草丛中穿梭觅食。它们专注于发草“冠层”下方的蓟草和矢车菊花籽。这些不成熟的金翅雀缺少成年鸟头部标志性的红黑...

body.en: Priestcliffe Lees, Derbyshire: What a sight – and sound – it was, this huge flock of juveniles, feeding as the wind thrashed the vegetation Stands of tufted hair-grass, some over a metre tall, burned beige by the summer heat, were churned by strong autumn westerlies. Over and through the vegetation’s swaying lather roved a flock of about 200 goldfinches, most of them this year’s young. They were intent on the hanks of thistle and knapweed seed which lay below the hair-grass “canopy”. These immature finches lack any of the red and black bands of the adult’s head. Instead of the smooth mocha buff on their parents’ underparts, the youngsters were dull and streaky. What they had to perfection were the semi-circular disks of yellow across each black wing, while every feather through that full fan was tipped with white. Continue reading...
body.zh: Priestcliffe Lees，德比郡：这是多么壮观的景象和声音啊，这群幼虫在风吹拂着植被时觅食。丛生的毛草丛生，有的一米多高，在夏季的炎热中被晒成米色，在秋季强劲的西风的搅动下，丛生的毛草丛生了。大约 200 只金翅雀在植被摇曳的泡沫中穿梭，其中大多数是今年的幼鸟。他们专注于毛草“树冠”下方的蓟和矢车菊种子的绞束。这些未成熟的雀没有成年雀头上的任何红色和黑色带子。与父母下身光滑的摩卡浅黄色不同，年轻人的肤色暗淡且有条纹。他们所需要的完美之处在于每个黑色翅膀上都有黄色的半圆形圆盘，而整个扇子上的每根羽毛都带有白色的尖端。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The author describes a vibrant scene at Priestcliffe Lees, where about 200 young goldfinches feed amidst the wind-tossed grasses. This vivid display of life, a part of Yahweh's creation, is in a state of flux, subject to the elements and the cycles of nature. The Apostle Paul speaks of all creation groaning as it awaits its ultimate redemption and renewal.
reflection.zh: 作者在普里斯特克利夫草地描绘了一幅生动的景象，约200只年轻的金翅雀在风吹草动的草丛中觅食。这充满活力的生命景象，是雅伟创造的一部分，正处于变化之中，受制于自然界的元素和循环。使徒保罗谈到，万物都在一同叹息，等候着最终的救赎和更新。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.

title.en: Iceland, One of Three Countries That Still Hunts Whales, Considers Ban
title.zh: 冰岛，仍捕鲸的三国之一，考虑禁止

summary.en: Iceland is one of only three countries, alongside Norway and Japan, that still permits commercial whaling. However, the Icelandic government is set to introduce a bill in February that could lead to a ban on the practice. This year, Iceland has permitted the hunting of up to 134 minke whales and 150 fin whales by its...
summary.zh: 冰岛是仅有的三个仍允许商业捕鲸的国家之一，与挪威和日本并列。然而，冰岛政府将于二月提出一项可能禁止该做法的法案。今年，冰岛已允许其最后一个捕鲸公司Hvalur捕杀多达134头小须鲸和150头长须鲸。虽然小须鲸并非濒危物种，但长须鲸已被国际自然保护联盟列为易危物种。迄今为止，冰岛已捕杀了80头成年长须鲸，有报道称被鱼叉射...

body.en:
Iceland is one of just three countries, along with Norway and Japan, that still allows commercial whaling in its waters, but that may be about to change. The Icelandic government will put forward a bill in February that could ban the practice.

The Icelandic government will allow for as many as 134 minke whales and 150 fin whales to be killed this year by its last remaining whaling company, Hvalur. While minke whales are not a threatened species, fin whales are classified as vulnerable to extinction by the International Union for Conservation of Nature. So far this year, 80 adult fin whales have been killed in Iceland, where authorities have found that harpooned animals often endure immense suffering. A 2023 report released by the Icelandic Food and Veterinary Authority determined that some harpooned whales can take up to two hours to die. The government is now looking to update its whaling law, it says, and will consider a permanent ban on whaling. “This is a really significant milestone in efforts to consign to history Iceland’s cruel and needless whale hunts,” said Wendy Higgins , a spokesperson for Humane World for Animals.

Over the past two decades, Icelandic whalers have killed more than 1,000 fin whales, according to Humane World for Animals, which says that most of the whale meat produced is consumed not by Icelanders but by visiting tourists.

Whaling in the early 20th century decimated populations of cetaceans around the world, leading countries to agree to an international ban on whale hunting in 1986. Despite the ban, Norway resumed commercial whaling in 1993, Iceland in 2006, and Japan in 2019.
body.zh: 冰岛是仅有的三个仍然允许在其水域进行商业捕鲸的国家之一，但这种情况可能即将改变。冰岛政府将于二月份提出一项法案，可能禁止这种做法。 冰岛政府今年将允许其最后一家捕鲸公司 Hvalur 捕杀多达 134 头小须鲸和 150 头长须鲸。虽然小须鲸不是受威胁物种，但长须鲸被国际自然保护联盟列为易危物种。今年到目前为止，冰岛已有 80 头成年长须鲸被杀，当局发现被鱼叉刺伤的动物常常承受巨大的痛苦。冰岛食品和兽医局 2023 年发布的一份报告确定，一些鱼叉鲸可能需要两个小时才能死亡。政府表示，目前正在寻求更新捕鲸法，并将考虑永久禁止捕鲸。人道动物世界发言人温迪·希金斯 (Wendy Higgins) 表示：“这确实是一个重要的里程碑，旨在让冰岛残忍和不必要的鲸鱼捕猎成为历史。” 根据动物人道世界的数据，在过去的二十年里，冰岛捕鲸者已经捕杀了 1000 多头长须鲸，该组织表示，生产的大部分鲸肉不是由冰岛人食用，而是由来访的游客食用。 20 世纪初的捕鲸活动导致世界各地的鲸目动物数量锐减，导致各国于 1986 年同意国际禁止捕鲸。尽管有这项禁令，挪威还是于 1993 年恢复了商业捕鲸，冰岛于 2006 年恢复了商业捕鲸，日本于 2019 年恢复了商业捕鲸。

This situation calls to mind the ancient wisdom to "Speak up for those who cannot speak for themselves, for all their rights." The potential ban reflects a growing awareness and a moral imperative to protect species facing extinction....

verse.textZh: 你当为不能自辩的开口，为孤独的伸冤。你当开口按公义判断，为困苦和穷乏的辨屈。

While my dessert and cooking apples have...
summary.zh: 兰斯通，汉普郡：我的花园里长满了维多利亚李子，但它们本不该是脆的。今年夏天对花园里的果树来说充满挑战，酷热和缺雨导致收成不佳、过早成熟和采摘前落果。虽然我的食用和烹饪苹果只结了寥寥几颗矮小、像海棠果一样大的果实，榅桲也光秃秃的，但温室旁那棵维多利亚李子树却是个例外。它的枝头挂满了果实，甚至有几根枝条因不堪重负而折断。

body.en: Langstone, Hampshire: My garden is full of Victoria plums, but they’re not supposed to be crunchy inside This summer has been challenging for the fruit trees in my garden, with intense heat and a lack of rain causing poor cropping, premature ripening and pre-harvest drop. While my dessert and cooking apples have produced just a handful of stunted, crab-apple-sized fruit, and my quince is bare, the Victoria plum growing next to the greenhouse is the exception. Its branches are so heavily laden that several have snapped under the weight. Continue reading...
body.zh: 汉普郡兰斯通：我的花园里长满了维多利亚李子，但它们的内部不应该是脆的。今年夏天对我花园里的果树来说是一个挑战，高温和缺乏雨水导致作物歉收、过早成熟和收获前落果。虽然我的甜点和烹饪苹果只结出了一些发育不良、海棠大小的水果，而且我的榅桲也光秃秃的，但生长在温室旁边的维多利亚李是个例外。它的树枝太重了，有几根在重压下折断了。继续阅读...

reflection.en: The intense heat and drought this summer have severely impacted the fruit trees in the author's garden, leading to stunted growth and premature ripening. This mirrors the hardship described in Habakkuk, where even the fig trees and olive trees may fail, and the fields yield no food. Yet, even amidst such scarcity, the passage calls for finding joy in...
reflection.zh: 今年夏天酷热和干旱严重影响了作者花园里的果树，导致生长受阻和过早成熟。这与哈巴谷书中所描述的困境相似，在那里，无花果树和橄榄树可能都会枯干，田地也毫无收成。然而，即使在这种匮乏之中，这段经文仍呼吁在救恩的雅伟上帝里喜乐。

verse.textEn: Though the fig tree does not bud and there are no grapes on the vines... yet I will rejoice in Yahweh.
verse.textZh: 虽然无花果树不发旺，葡萄树不结果……然而，我要因雅伟欢欣。

title.en: Rabbits are the biggest threat to Australia’s native species. Why are their numbers booming again?
title.zh: 兔子是澳大利亚本土物种的最大威胁。它们的数量为何又在激增？

summary.en: Scientists attribute the growing populations of rabbits across Australia to good rainfall and increasing resistance to viruses. This surge is placing significant pressure on native species, with conservation efforts like those using rabbit-detecting dogs in South Australia working overtime.
summary.zh: 科学家们将澳大利亚各地兔子数量的激增归因于充沛的降雨和病毒抗性的增强。这种激增给本土物种带来了巨大压力，南澳大利亚等地使用兔子探测犬等保护工作正加紧进行。

body.en: Good rainfall and growing resistance to viruses are to blame for growing populations around the country, scientists say Sign up for climate and environment editor Adam Morton’s free Clear Air newsletter here Jojo the rabbit-detecting dog is working eight days on, two days off, running up to 20km a day chasing rabbits in the south-west of Bon Bon reserve in South Australia’s arid centre. “She’s being kept very busy,” says Dr Pat Taggart, an ecologist with Bush Heritage Australia, a conservation body that owns the former sheep property. Sign up to get climate and environment editor Adam Morton’s Clear Air column as a free newsletter Continue reading...
body.zh: 科学家表示，全国人口不断增长的原因在于良好的降雨量和对病毒的抵抗力增强。兔子探测犬 Jojo 正在南澳大利亚干旱中心的 Bon Bon 保护区西南部连续工作 8 天，休息两天，每天奔跑 20 公里，追逐兔子。 “她一直很忙，”澳大利亚布什遗产保护机构的生态学家帕特·塔格特博士说，该组织是一个拥有这片前羊财产的保护机构。注册以获取气候与环境编辑 Adam Morton 的 Clear Air 专栏作为免费时事通讯 继续阅读...

reflection.en: The natural world groans under the weight of imbalance, as described in Romans 8:22. The booming rabbit population in Australia, while a biological phenomenon, highlights how disruptions in ecosystems can lead to widespread distress for native flora and fauna. It calls us to consider our role in maintaining the delicate balance of creation.
reflection.zh: 正如罗马书8:22所描述的，大自然在失衡的重压下发出呻吟。澳大利亚兔子数量的激增，虽然是一个生物学现象，却凸显了生态系统的破坏如何导致本土动植物广泛的困境。这促使我们反思在维持受造界微妙平衡中所扮演的角色。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: The Breakdown of Natural Systems Could Intensify Warming by 30 Percent
title.zh: 自然系统失灵可能加剧变暖30%

summary.en: As the planet heats up, natural systems like tundras, wetlands, and forests are breaking down, releasing significant emissions that amplify human-caused warming. Research suggests these feedback loops could intensify global warming by 20 to 30 percent, adding further temperature increases even if net zero emissions...
summary.zh: 随着地球变暖，苔原解冻、湿地发酵、森林遭受更频繁的野火，这些自然系统的崩溃释放出大量排放物，加剧了人类活动造成的变暖。研究表明，这些反馈循环可能将人为变暖加剧20%至30%。

body.en:
As the planet heats up, tundras are thawing, wetlands are fermenting, and forests are succumbing to larger and more frequent wildfires. The breakdown of these natural systems is unleashing huge volumes of emissions, further intensifying warming from the burning of fossil fuels. According to new research, such feedback loops could amplify human-driven warming by 20 to 30 percent.

Even if humans reach net zero emissions later this century, feedbacks would add another 0.2 degrees C of warming, according to the modeling study , published this week in Environmental Research Letters. And if the world fails to reach net zero, and countries continue to produce some residual emissions through the end of this century, the added warming would be closer to 0.4 degrees C.

The world is already 1.4 degrees C hotter than in the preindustrial era, and fossil fuel emissions continue to grow, putting the Earth on course to surpass 2.5 degrees C of warming this century, scientists say, well in breach of international climate targets. And yet, while the added warming from feedback loops will further hasten the rise in temperatures, emissions from the breakdown of natural systems are largely absent from the most influential climate models, those that inform climate negotiations.

“This hidden multiplier is missing from the models guiding climate policy, so those models are likely underestimating how much warming is coming — and overestimating how much carbon we can still afford to emit,” said lead author Sam Abernethy, a researcher at Spark Climate Solutions, a San Francisco-based nonprofit that aims to identify climate “blind spots” and account for them in policy. ”To close that gap, we need to understand these processes better and build them into the models we rely on.”

The challenges are steep. Feedback loops are difficult to model, and emissions data is lacking in hard-to-reach places, such as Siberia or the Congo Basin. But as Yale Environment 360 recently reported , scientists around the world are now racing to forecast emissions from natural systems.

“If you’re not including all the emissions going into the atmosphere, you’re hamstrung from the get-go,” Brian Buma, a climate scientist at the Environmental Defense Fund, told e360 . “People are recognizing that the longer we go without taking these emissions into account, there’s just going to be a bigger gap.”
body.zh: 随着地球变暖，苔原正在融化，湿地正在发酵，森林正在遭受更大、更频繁的野火的袭击。这些自然系统的崩溃正在释放大量的排放物，进一步加剧了化石燃料燃烧造成的变暖。根据新的研究，这种反馈循环可能会使人类造成的变暖幅度扩大 20％ 至 30％。 根据本周发表在《环境研究快报》上的模型研究，即使人类在本世纪晚些时候达到净零排放，反馈也会使气温再增加 0.2 摄氏度。如果世界未能实现净零排放，并且各国在本世纪末继续产生一些残余排放，则升温幅度将接近 0.4 摄氏度。 科学家表示，世界温度已经比工业化前时代高出 1.4 摄氏度，而化石燃料排放量继续增加，使地球本世纪升温将超过 2.5 摄氏度，这远远违反了国际气候目标。然而，虽然反馈循环带来的额外变暖将进一步加速气温上升，但最有影响力的气候模型（为气候谈判提供信息的模型）基本上不存在自然系统崩溃造成的排放。 “指导气候政策的模型中缺少这个隐藏的乘数，因此这些模型可能低估了即将到来的变暖程度，并高估了我们仍然能够承受的碳排放量，”主要作者萨姆·阿伯内西（Sam Abernethy）说，他是旧金山非营利组织 Spark Climate Solutions 的研究员，旨在识别气候“盲点”并在政策中加以考虑。 “为了缩小这一差距，我们需要更好地理解这些过程，并将它们构建到我们依赖的模型中。” 挑战是严峻的。反馈回路很难建模，西伯利亚或刚果盆地等难以到达的地方缺乏排放数据。但正如耶鲁环境 360 最近报道的那样，世界各地的科学家现在正在竞相预测自然系统的排放量。 美国环境保护基金会的气候科学家布莱恩·布马 (Brian Buma) 告诉 e360：“如果不包括进入大气中的所有排放量，那么从一开始就会受到阻碍。” “人们认识到，不考虑这些排放的时间越长，差距就会越大。”

reflection.en: The prophet Isaiah spoke of creation's deep distress, and Paul echoed this, describing all of creation groaning as if in labor pains. This news report details how our planet's natural systems are indeed suffering, releasing emissions that worsen the climate crisis. It calls us to acknowledge this shared distress and seek healing for the earth.
reflection.zh: 先知以赛亚曾预言，万物都在痛苦呻吟，保罗也呼应说，受造之物如同经历生产之苦。这篇报道详细说明了我们星球的自然系统确实正在遭受痛苦，释放出加剧气候危机的排放物。这提醒我们，要认识到这共同的痛苦，并寻求治愈大地。

verse.textEn: We know that the whole creation has been groaning as in the pains of childbirth right up to the present time.
verse.textZh: 我们知道，一切受造之物一同叹息、劳苦，直到如今。

title.en: Rose Abdoo Can’t Wait for the ‘Gilmore Girls’ Documentary — and Says It ‘Gets Greater Later’ at 63
title.zh: 罗斯·阿布杜不期待“吉尔莫女孩”纪录片——并表示她63岁时“晚年更精彩”

summary.en: Rose Abdoo, known for her role as Gypsy on 'Gilmore Girls,' expressed her eagerness to participate in an upcoming documentary about the beloved series. She also reflected on her career, including her work on 'Hacks,' and is embarking on a new chapter with CBS's 'Eternally Yours.'
summary.zh: 罗斯·阿布杜（Rose Abdoo）以在《吉尔莫女孩》中饰演吉普赛（Gypsy）而闻名，她表示渴望参与一部关于这部备受喜爱的电视剧的纪录片。她还回顾了自己的演艺生涯，包括在《黑客》（Hacks）中的工作，并正在与CBS的《永恒的你》（Eternally Yours）开启新的篇章。

body.en:
By providing your information, you agree to our Terms of Use and our Privacy Policy . We use vendors that may also process your information to help provide our services. This site is protected by reCAPTCHA Enterprise and the Google Privacy Policy and Terms of Service apply.

Rose Abdoo is ready to go back to Stars Hollow. The actress, best known for playing Gypsy on “ Gilmore Girls ” and Josefina on the Emmy-winning “Hacks,” recently told IndieWire she’s eager to participate in an upcoming documentary about the beloved WB and CW series.

“I sent Lauren [Graham] a message immediately saying, ‘Please let me be involved in this in any way,’” Abdoo said, noting that she also played a second character in the “Gilmore Girls” universe. “Gypsy and Berta, double casting! I want to be in it somehow. I would love that.”

HBO Max is currently producing the untitled nonfiction project to mark the show’s 25th anniversary. It’s expected to feature creator and showrunner Amy Sherman-Palladino, executive producer Daniel Palladino, star Graham, and other cast and crew members. Interviews are expected to run alongside new behind-the-scenes footage, outtakes, and original script pages. Related Stories Michelle Khare Says YouTube’s Upload Button Is Changing Who Gets to Make Prestige TV Neil Jordan on Making His Homoerotic ‘Interview with the Vampire’ for a Major Studio with A-List Stars

Bonni Cohen directs the documentary, which doesn’t yet have a release date. But Abdoo said she just had lunch with Sally Struthers, who played Babette on the series, and told IndieWire that she remains close with many former co-stars. Abdoo is hopeful any “Gilmore Girls” documentary will capture the relationships that formed during the show’s original run.

“That was a wonderful friendship that came out of that show,” she said of Struthers.

“Gilmore Girls” originally aired on The WB from 2000 to 2006 before moving to The CW for its seventh and final season. It returned with the 2016 Netflix revival miniseries “Gilmore Girls: A Year in the Life.” The fanbase has continued to grow, something Abdoo attributes to its cozy ambiance and generational storytelling.

“It’s a comforting town to be part of,” she said. “Every fall people want to just be back in Stars Hollow.” The series’ appeal, Abdoo added, comes from the way people of all ages can coexist within the same fictional universe. She also sees that quality in “ Hacks ,” where the bond between Jean Smart’s Deborah and Hannah Einbinder’s Ava bridges a significant age gap.

This reflects the wisdom of Ecclesiastes, which reminds us that there is a time for every purpose under heaven. As she looks back with fondness and forward with anticipation, we are reminded that each season of life has its...
reflection.zh: 罗斯·阿布杜（Rose Abdoo）热切期待一部关于她在《吉尔莫女孩》时期经历的纪录片，认为这是重温人生重要篇章的机会。这呼应了《传道书》的智慧，提醒我们“凡事都有定期，天下万务都有定时”。当我们带着怀念回顾过去，又满怀期待地展望未来时，我们被提醒，生命的每个季节都有其独特的价值和意义。

verse.textEn: There is a time for everything, and a season for every activity under the heavens.
